title: Off-Page SEO & Outreach Specialist
description:
Remote — Philippines | Full-time · 



Build real authority for US clients through outreach, guest posts and earned mentions, and help us shape how that practice runs. 



Rohring Results is a US marketing agency of about thirty people. We run SEO, paid advertising, social and creative, content, web development and custom software for businesses across the US, many of them home-services and local companies. Our delivery team works from the Philippines. 



Our SEO team has four specialists under a department lead. This seat owns everything off-page: backlink audits, toxic-link decisions, outreach campaigns, guest posts and self-published articles for clients. We have the platform and the content engine to do this well, and we are hiring someone to run the outreach side as a real practice. 



Our writing engine drafts placement content. You d
 whether it is good enough to ship, where it goes, and who we pitch. 



What you will do 



-Audit each client's backlink profile and flag the links that hurt it. 

-Find and qualify publishers, write pitches and land guest posts and mentions. 

-Approve and publish client articles on platforms like Medium, LinkedIn and Substack. 

-Make disavow decisions and log your reasoning. 

-Turn our quarterly off-page research into a prioritized work queue. 

-Help write our outreach playbook and link-quality standard. 



What we are looking for 



-3+ years in off-page SEO with outreach, guest posting or digital PR, and placements you can show. 

-You judge links on relevance and context, not just a score. 

-Pitches that editors answer. 

-Current knowledge of link spam policies. We do not buy links or use link networks. 

-You can run campaigns for several clients at once. 

-Strong written English. 



Nice to have 



Search Atlas, Ahrefs or Semrush. Publishing on Medium, LinkedIn or Substack. Local or home-services clients. Experience building an outreach process from scratch. 



How we work 



-Remote, Philippines-based. Core hours are 9am–1pm Philippine Time every workday. The rest of your hours are flexible within the same day. 



-Time tracking. We track hours in Hubstaff against client projects, so each client gets the time they pay for. It also records activity data, and we do not use that to judge how well you do your job. 



-AI is part of the work. We use AI tools across the company. We want people who use them well and check what comes back, not people who trust them blindly or refuse to use them. 



We are still building. Some of our processes are newer than we would like. You will help shape how this work runs, not only follow a finished playbook. 



How to apply 



Send Applications to 
 with your CV, send short answers (a paragraph each) to these questions. We read these first; they tell us more than a cover letter. 



1. Tell us about a link or placement opportunity you turned down, and why. 



2. Paste the opening of a real outreach pitch you sent that got a yes, and tell us what made it work. 



Applications without the answers will not be reviewed.

title: SEO Account Manager (SEO Strategy & On-Page)
description:
Own SEO strategy, research and on-page for a book of US clients, starting from who the customer is, not from a keyword list. 



Rohring Results is a US marketing agency of about thirty people. We run SEO, paid advertising, social and creative, content, web development and custom software for businesses across the US, many of them home-services and local companies. Our delivery team works from the Philippines. 



Our SEO team has four specialists (technical, local, off-page and this seat) under a department lead. This seat owns the thinking: buyer research, competitive benchmarking, keyword and intent strategy, on-page direction, the monthly content plan, and the strategy each client works from. This is not a client-relations role. You will work on the SEO account itself, and our Client Relations team owns the client conversation. 



On our larger clients we run an automated agent that proposes on-page fixes. You approve every change individually, because a fix is only right in the context of the strategy behind it. Client content is drafted by an AI writing engine we built and refined by our Copywriter; you hold the final review before it is published. 



What you will do 



-Research each client's buyers and competitors, and turn that into keyword, intent and topic plans. 

-Approve or reject automated on-page changes one at a time, and hand-build schema on the pages that matter most. 

-Brief the month's content, then review and publish it. 

-Run quarterly site audits and d
 what gets fixed first. 

-D
 what goes to our technical specialist and what goes to our web team, then check it was done. 

-Prepare the inputs for monthly client reports and check the reports before they go out. 



What we are looking for 



-3+ years of hands-on SEO strategy, ideally at an agency with several clients at once. 

-Real research skill: you can read reviews, forums and search data and find the pattern in them. 

-Google Search Console and GA4 at analysis depth. 

-You can write and validate JSON-LD schema by hand. 

-You can write a brief a writer can use, and send back a draft that is not good enough. 

-You would rather tell a client the realistic answer than the encouraging one. 

-Clear written English. 



Nice to have 



Search Atlas or a similar SEO platform. Rank Math. Microsoft Clarity. Bing Webmaster Tools. Local SEO. A considered view of where AI-generated content and reports can be trusted. 



How we work 



-Remote, Philippines-based. Core hours are 9am–1pm Philippine Time every workday. The rest of your hours are flexible within the same day. 



-Time tracking. We track hours in Hubstaff against client projects, so each client gets the time they pay for. It also records activity data, and we do not use that to judge how well you do your job. 



-AI is part of the work. We use AI tools across the company. We want people who use them well and check what comes back, not people who trust them blindly or refuse to use them. 



We are still building. Some of our processes are newer than we would like. You will help shape how this work runs, not only follow a finished playbook. 



How to apply 



Send Applications to 
 with your CV, send short answers (a paragraph each) to these questions. We read these first; they tell us more than a cover letter. 



1. Tell us about a high-volume keyword you deliberately did not target. Why? 



2. An automated tool proposes an on-page change that is technically correct but you think is wrong for this client. What do you do? 



Applications without the answers will not be reviewed.

title: Technical SEO Specialist
description:
Own the technical side of SEO for a book of US clients: crawl health, schema, and the analytics everything else is measured on. 



Rohring Results is a US marketing agency of about thirty people. We run SEO, paid advertising, social and creative, content, web development and custom software for businesses across the US, many of them home-services and local companies. Our delivery team works from the Philippines. 



Our SEO team has four specialists under a department lead, and this seat owns everything technical: site audits, crawl and index health, schema, sitemaps and the measurement setup. A real part of the job is that the plumbing often isn't there. A client may have no GA4, no conversion tracking, lost access or a brand-new site, and you build it rather than file a ticket about it. 



What you will do 



-Set up new clients end to end: tracking pixel, Search Console, GA4 with lead tracking, Bing Webmaster Tools, sitemaps and behavior analytics. 

-Find technical problems across every client site, sort them by severity and fix what is assigned to you. 

-Check that automated on-page changes actually went live, and catch them when they didn't. 

-Investigate indexing problems with deep crawls. 

-Write and validate structured data. 

-Support site launches and migrations so rankings survive the move. 



What we are looking for 



-2+ years of hands-on technical SEO. 

-Deep crawler experience, not just default crawls. 

-GA4 and Google Tag Manager at implementation depth. You can prove a conversion event fires. 

-JSON-LD written and validated by hand. 

-WordPress and SEO plugin know-how. 

-You check whether things work, not only whether they were configured. 

-Clear written English. 



Nice to have 



Search Atlas or a similar platform. Bing Webmaster Tools. Microsoft Clarity. Log file analysis. JavaScript-heavy sites. Migrations. 



How we work 



-Remote, Philippines-based. Core hours are 9am–1pm Philippine Time every workday. The rest of your hours are flexible within the same day. 



-Time tracking. We track hours in Hubstaff against client projects, so each client gets the time they pay for. It also records activity data, and we do not use that to judge how well you do your job. 



-AI is part of the work. We use AI tools across the company. We want people who use them well and check what comes back, not people who trust them blindly or refuse to use them. 



We are still building. Some of our processes are newer than we would like. You will help shape how this work runs, not only follow a finished playbook. 



How to apply 



Send Applications to 
 with your CV, send short answers (a paragraph each) to these questions. We read these first; they tell us more than a cover letter. 



1. A client's GA4 has been connected for a year with no conversion events. What do you do first, and what do you tell the account team about the last year of reports? 



2. Tell us about a technical assumption you found in documentation and checked. What did you find? 



Applications without the answers will not be reviewed.

title: Ads Manager (Google Ads & Meta)
description:
Own paid advertising end to end for a book of US clients, from the pre-launch check to the monthly report, and set the standards for how we run it. 



Rohring Results is a US marketing agency of about thirty people. We run SEO, paid advertising, social and creative, content, web development and custom software for businesses across the US, many of them home-services and local companies. Our delivery team works from the Philippines. 



We are hiring an Ads Manager to own paid advertising outright: the retargeting built into our client packages, the standalone Google and Meta campaigns we sell, and the pre-launch review that d
 whether a client's ads are ready to go live. This is a build-it role as much as a run-it role. Our other departments have documented processes; paid advertising needs someone who wants to write them. 



What you will do 



-Check every new client's accounts, tracking, landing pages and compliance before launch, and hold a launch that is not ready. 

-Build, launch and optimize Google Ads and Meta campaigns, including retargeting. 

-Set up conversion tracking and attribution so we report leads and jobs, not just clicks. 

-Manage spend inside each client's approved budget. 

-Research audiences and competitor ads. 

-Write the monthly paid ads report. 

-Write the playbook for how our paid department runs. 



What we are looking for 



-4+ years hands-on in both Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager. 

-Strong tracking skills: GTM, GA4, Meta pixel and Conversions API. 

-Retargeting built from real client data. 

-Good judgment on small budgets. 

-You will say "not ready" and explain why. 

-Clear written English. 



Nice to have 



Agency experience. Local or home-services clients. Enhanced conversions and offline conversion imports. Call tracking. Restricted-industry ad policy. Landing-page optimization. 



How we work 



-Remote, Philippines-based. Core hours are 9am–1pm Philippine Time every workday. The rest of your hours are flexible within the same day. 



-Time tracking. We track hours in Hubstaff against client projects, so each client gets the time they pay for. It also records activity data, and we do not use that to judge how well you do your job. 



-AI is part of the work. We use AI tools across the company. We want people who use them well and check what comes back, not people who trust them blindly or refuse to use them. 



-We are still building. Some of our processes are newer than we would like. You will help shape how this work runs, not only follow a finished playbook. 



A few honest things 



This is a department of one today, reporting to our Strategy Manager. There is no ready-made playbook to step into, and we would rather say so now than have you find out in month two. 



How to apply 



Send your application to 
 with your CV, send short answers (a paragraph each) to these questions. We read these first; they tell us more than a cover letter. 



1. Tell us about the last time you refused to launch a campaign someone wanted live. What was wrong, and what did you say? 



2. A client's platform-reported conversions and their CRM disagree widely. How do you work out which is closer to the truth? 



Applications without the answers will not be reviewed.
salary: To be discuss based on experience

title: Strategy Manager — Research & Marketing Strategy
description:
About the Role 



If you are the person who reads three sources when one would do—and cannot let a “because that's how it works in this industry” go unchecked—this role may be for you. 



Rohring Results is a US-based marketing agency providing SEO, Google & Meta Ads, social media, content, creative,
 marketing, and web development for clients across multiple industries. 



We are hiring a Strategy Manager to own the strategic direction behind our client work. 



This is not a single-channel marketing role. You will connect research, positioning, SEO, paid advertising, social media, content,
, creative, and web strategy into one coherent plan. 



More importantly: 



This is a research job with a strategy title. 



Your job is to find out what is actually true about a market, a buyer, a competitive landscape, and a client's position—and then determine what the client should do about it. 



When the research is strong, everything downstream becomes stronger. When the research is shallow, every channel can end up confidently solving the wrong problem. 



What You'll Actually Do 



1. Lead Client Strategy 



-You will own the strategy for new clients, including: 

-Developing the overall marketing strategy and direction 

-Connecting multiple channels into one integrated plan 

-Identifying the client's biggest growth opportunities 

-Determining what should be prioritized and why 

-Translating research into clear strategic recommendations 

-Making sure SEO, paid, social, content,
, creative, and web efforts work toward the same objectives 



2. Conduct Deep Marketing Research 



-You will personally conduct or direct research involving: 

-Buyer and audience research 

-Customer personas 

-Competitive analysis 

-Industry and market research 

-Brand positioning 

-Audience research for paid campaigns 

-Competitor messaging and offer analysis 

-Market trends and opportunities 



We are looking for someone who actually does the research, not someone who simply delegates it. 



You should be able to take a research project, explain your methodology, show your sources, challenge your assumptions, and explain how you determined that your conclusions were reliable. 



3. Build Brand Foundations 



Many of our clients do not have clearly defined brand guidelines or positioning. 



You will help establish: 



-Brand positioning 

-Differentiation 

-Target audience 

-Brand voice 

-Key messaging 

-Value propositions 

-Messaging angles 



Our copywriters and designers will use these strategic foundations to create the actual deliverables. 



You don't need to be the person writing every headline. You need to know which headline should exist and why. 



4. Review and Approve Content & Creative 



You will have real strategic authority over work before it reaches the client. 



You will: 



-Review content and creative deliverables 

-Identify when something does not align with strategy 

-Give clear and actionable feedback 

-Approve or reject work before client delivery 

-Explain why something needs to change 

-Ensure the final output reflects the research and strategy 



You should be comfortable telling someone, including someone who does not report to you, that their work is not ready—and giving them enough direction to fix it. 



5. Direct
 Campaign Strategy 



You will determine: 



-Target audience 

-Campaign objective 

-Offer 

-Messaging angle 

-Sequence 

-Call to action 



Our copywriter will write the
s. 



You provide the strategic brief and approve the final work. 



6. Analyze Client Performance 



You will produce and review client performance reports using AI-assisted tools. 



But generating a report is only the beginning. 



You will need to determine: 



-What actually happened? 

-Why did it happen? 

-Which numbers matter? 

-Which numbers are misleading? 

-What changed from the previous period? 

-What should we do next? 

-Does the data actually support the story the report is telling? 

-We need someone who can question the report, not just format it. 



AI Is a Major Part of This Role 



Every agency says it uses AI. 



Here's what we actually mean. 



Our teams already use AI to draft, research, brainstorm, and refine work. That is not what makes this position different. 



Your job is to be exceptionally good at getting reliable information out of AI tools—and knowing when the information is wrong. 



You will be expected to: 



-Frame research questions that produce specific, useful answers rather than generic summaries 

-Build effective prompts and research workflows 

-Iterate instead of accepting the first response 

-Cross-check AI-generated information 

-Identify unsupported claims and hallucinations 

-Understand what an AI model can and cannot reliably know 

-Know when AI should not be used 

-Use primary sources, customer reviews, forums, sales calls, interviews, analytics, and other sources when appropriate 

-Turn research into documented, reusable strategic resources 

-Anyone can get an answer from AI. We need someone who can determine whether the answer is actually true. 



During the hiring process, we may assess this skill directly. 



If you can describe a time when an AI tool gave you an answer that looked correct but wasn't—and explain how you caught it—we want to hear about it. 



What You'll Own 



-Overall marketing strategy for new clients 

-Integrated multi-channel strategy 

-Market and industry research 

-Buyer and audience research 

-Competitive analysis 

-Brand positioning and differentiation 

-Customer personas 

-Paid advertising audience strategy 

-Content and creative direction 

-Content and creative approval 


 campaign strategy 

-Client performance reporting 

-Strategic recommendations based on performance data 

-Ongoing independent research 

-Documentation of research methods and strategic frameworks 

-Dedicated Research Time 



A portion of every week will be protected for research that is not tied to a specific client. 



This is intentional. 



We want someone who actively studies markets, competitors, technology, consumer behavior, marketing trends, and emerging opportunities. 



Nobody will necessarily be waiting for the output. 



That's the point. 



You need to be the kind of person who can take unstructured time and turn it into something valuable. 



 

What We're Looking For 



Required 



Multi-Channel Marketing Strategy Experience 



You have experience setting direction across multiple channels, ideally including: 



-SEO 

-Google Ads 

-Meta Ads 

-Social Media 

-Content Marketing 


 Marketing 

-Brand Strategy 



We are not looking for someone who specializes in one channel and simply coordinates the others. 



Strong Research Experience 



You have personally conducted work such as: 



-Market research 

-Competitive analysis 

-Customer research 

-Personas 

-Brand positioning 

-Audience research 

-Industry analysis 



Be prepared to walk us through a real project in detail. 



Genuine Curiosity 

One of the strongest indicators of success in this role is curiosity. 

We want someone who has gone deep into a subject simply because they wanted to understand it. 

It does not have to be marketing. 

Strong AI Research Skills 

You understand AI as a research and reasoning instrument, not simply a faster way to write. 



You should be comfortable: 

-Prompting 

-Iterating 

-Fact-checking 

-Comparing sources 

-Challenging AI outputs 

-Building repeatable AI research workflows 



We may assess this skill live. 



Strong Critical Thinking 



You naturally ask: 



-How do we know this? 

-What is the source? 

-What assumption are we making? 

-What would prove this wrong? 

-Is there another explanation? 

-What information are we missing? 

-Comfortable Giving Direct Feedback 



You will have authority over work produced by other team members. 



You need to be comfortable saying: 



“This isn't right yet.” 



More importantly, you need to explain exactly what needs to change and why. 



-Self-Directed 

-Some of the most important work in this position will not come with a deadline. 

-You need to be able to identify valuable work, prioritize it, and execute without someone constantly telling you what to do next. 

-Communication 

-Excellent written English 

-Strong analytical communication 

-Comfortable working with US-based clients and colleagues 

-Able to explain complex strategic ideas clearly 

-Comfortable participating in client-facing discussions 



 



Nice to Have 



Experience with: 

-Digital marketing agencies 

-Google Ads 

-Meta Ads 

-Paid audience and targeting strategy 

-Google Search Console 

-GA4 

-SEO platforms and analytics 

-Marketing dashboards and reporting 

-Competitive intelligence 

-Brand strategy 

-Marketing automation 

-AI research workflows 

-Creating documented processes that another person can follow 



 

What This Job Is NOT 



This may not be the right role if you are primarily looking for: 



A content writing position 



An SEO specialist position 



A paid ads specialist position 



A social media manager position 



A role where someone else provides the strategy 



A position where you simply execute instructions 



A job where AI is used primarily to generate content faster 



Our copywriters write. Our designers design. Our specialists execute. 



You determine what should be done, why it should be done, who it should reach, and how we know it is working. 



 

About the Working Environment 



This is a senior individual contributor position. 



There are no direct reports, but the role comes with real strategic authority. 



Client-facing work does not move forward without your approval. 



Rohring Results is a growing company, so not every process is perfectly established. Part of this role will involve helping us improve and document how strategy is developed and delivered. 



Our delivery team primarily works on Philippine hours, including daily stand-ups. 



Some client-facing meetings may take place during US hours. We will explain the expected schedule during the interview process. 



 



How to Apply 



Please submit your CV/Resume along with two short paragraphs answering the following: 



1. A Research Question You Answered Well 



Tell us: 



What were you trying to find out? 



How did you conduct the research? 



What sources did you use? 



How did you evaluate the information? 



How did you know your conclusion was reliable? 



What decision did the research ultimately influence? 



2. A Time AI Gave You the Wrong Answer 



Tell us about a situation where: 



An AI tool gave you an answer that appeared reasonable 



You discovered that it was wrong or misleading 



Explain how you identified the problem 



Explain how you verified the correct information 



Explain what you changed in your process afterward 



We read these answers before the rest of the application. 



Send to 



They will tell us much more about how you think than a generic cover letter.

description:
Own the voice and quality of everything we publish for our clients, and d
 what is good enough to ship. 



Rohring Results is a US marketing agency of about thirty people. We run SEO, paid advertising, social and creative, content, web development and custom software for businesses across the US, many of them home-services and local companies. Our delivery team works from the Philippines. 



We are direct about how our content gets made. We built an AI writing engine, and it drafts. You optimize the draft, check it is true, and d
 whether it ships. That takes more range and judgment than writing from scratch, and this post asks for both. 



You will work across blog and SEO content, website copy,
 campaigns, press releases and FAQs, for a mix of clients with documented brand voices. You work with SEO, web, social and strategy, not inside one team. 



What you will do

-Build and send client
 campaigns from a strategy brief. 

-Write and refine website copy, press releases and FAQs. 

-Keep the reference examples that define good output for each client. 

-Write our house style guide and per-client voice notes. 



What we are looking for 



-3+ years of copywriting, with samples in SEO content,
 and web copy. 

-A clear editorial standard you can explain and defend. 

-You catch an invented statistic in a polished draft. 

-You can hold several client voices at once. 

-You work well from detailed briefs and run your own queue. 

-Excellent written English for US readers. 



Nice to have 



Agency experience. Press releases. Owning a style guide. Systematic AI output review. WordPress. ActiveCampaign or similar
 platforms. 



How we work 



-Remote, Philippines-based. Core hours are 9am–1pm Philippine Time every workday. The rest of your hours are flexible within the same day. 



-Time tracking. We track hours in Hubstaff against client projects, so each client gets the time they pay for. It also records activity data, and we do not use that to judge how well you do your job. 



-AI is part of the work. We use AI tools across the company. We want people who use them well and check what comes back, not people who trust them blindly or refuse to use them. 



We are still building. Some of our processes are newer than we would like. You will help shape how this work runs, not only follow a finished playbook.

, one web page. For one of them, tell us what you changed in editing and why.

title: Graphic & Multimedia Designer

We are looking for a talented and versatile Graphic & Multimedia Designer to join our creative team and support the visual needs of a growing digital marketing and web agency. 



This role is ideal for a creative professional who is confident in both graphic design and video editing and understands how strong visual content supports branding, advertising, social media, websites, and overall marketing performance. 



The right candidate should have strong design fundamentals, excellent visual judgment, and hands-on experience creating professional graphics, branded content, social media assets, digital advertisements, short-form videos, promotional videos, and other multimedia materials. 



You should be comfortable working across multiple brands and industries, adapting to different visual styles, following brand guidelines, and producing polished work that is both creative and effective. 



AI tools may be used as part of a modern workflow for brainstorming, research, ideation, or productivity support. However, this role requires genuine design ability, strong creative judgment, originality, and confidence using professional creative software. 



*Key Responsibilities 



Create high-quality visual assets for websites, landing pages, social media, paid advertising, email campaigns, presentations, and print materials. 



Design graphics for Meta/Facebook ads, Instagram content, Google Display ads, website banners, blog graphics, thumbnails, flyers, brochures, and other marketing collateral. 



Edit and produce short-form and promotional video content for social media, digital ads, websites, and marketing campaigns. 



Create engaging video content for platforms such as Instagram Reels,
, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other digital channels. 



Edit raw video footage into polished, brand-aligned content. 



Add transitions, text overlays, subtitles, captions, music, sound effects, branded elements, and basic motion graphics to video content.

title: Looking For An Experienced AI Video Editor
description:
Gotya (
) is the home of online pack ripping. We currently focus on Pokémon & OnePiece cards. You buy a digital pack, rip it live and pull a real, professionally graded trading card that ships to your door or sells back instantly for 90% of its live market value.



We grow through paid video on Meta and TikTok, and we test new creatives every week. We are looking for an experienced AI video editor who turns our scripts and briefs into finished direct response ads, fast and at a steady level. The target is around 20 videos per week.



You get scripts, briefs and assets from our creative team. You build each ad with AI video tools and classic editing, deliver every format, and upload it to our creatives dashboard. There you get feedback per video and see how your ads perform once they are live. Winning ads come back to you for new hooks and variations.



WHAT YOU WILL MAKE



- UGC-style ads with AI avatars and AI voiceovers

- 3D animated and character-driven ads

- Kinetic typography and motion graphics ads

- Fast reveal ads cut from real rips on our platform

- Proven ad structures from our market, rebuilt in the Gotya style

- New hooks on top of winning ads

- Every video in 9:16 and 4:5, with captions and the safe zones of each placement respected



ONE RULE: THE CARDS STAY REAL



Every card on Gotya is a real card stored in an insured vault. In our ads, AI builds the world around a card. The card or graded slab itself is never generated or changed by AI.



YOU HAVE



- 2+ years of editing direct response video ads for Meta and TikTok, for e-commerce, DTC brands, apps or SaaS

- Hands-on experience with AI video and image tools such as Kling, Veo, Sora, Higgsfield, Nano Banana, Runway or ElevenLabs, and you know which tool fits which shot

- Strong editing skills in Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or DaVinci Resolve

- A clear sense of what makes a performance ad work: a hook in the first seconds, tight pacing, readable captions and a clear call to action

- The capacity to deliver around 20 finished videos per week without dropping quality

- Good written English and a few hours of daily overlap with European working hours



NICE TO HAVE



- You know Pokémon, One Piece or the wider TCG world

- You work in 3D or motion design (Blender, Cinema 4D, After Effects)

- You pitch your own hook ideas next to the brief



WHAT WE OFFER



Fully remote with flexible hours. Long-term work with a steady weekly volume. Clear briefs, quick feedback and direct contact with the founders and the creative team. As the creative team grows, there is room to grow into a lead editor role.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully, we filter hard)



Start your application with the word SLABCUT. Applications without it are not read.



Then answer these six points, in this order:



1. EXPERIENCE. The brands you edited video ads for. Per brand: the niche (e-commerce, DTC brand, app, SaaS or other), the platforms (Meta, TikTok, other), the type of ads (UGC, AI avatar, motion graphics, 3D, other), how long you worked with them and, if you know them, the results of your ads.



2. PORTFOLIO. Links to 5 to 10 ads you edited, at least 3 of them made mostly with AI tools. Per link one line on what you did and which tools you used. Check that every link opens without a login or access request.



3. AI WORKFLOW. The AI tools you use today, and how one ad goes from brief to final file in your workflow.



4. AVAILABILITY. How many hours per week you can work for us, your time zone and working hours, your earliest start date, and whether you work for other clients right now. Add the highest weekly volume of finished ads you have delivered so far.



5. HOURLY RATE. Your hourly rate in USD.



6. PAID TEST TRIAL. Shortlisted editors get a paid test trial: a short assignment on a real Gotya brief. Are you OK with this paid test trial as part of the application process? Answer yes or no.



Applications without the code word or without these six points are deleted without reply.

title: Direct-Response Copywriter / Creative Strategist | Affiliate Offers
description:
We're an affiliate marketing agency looking for a direct-response copywriter and creative strategist for paid ads promoting nutra, telehealth, money/finance and other affiliate offers. You'll own audience research, angles and scripts, then work closely with media buyers and video editors to get concepts produced, tested and improved.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Research the audience, offer, competitors and existing ads. Find useful customer language, objections, desires and credible proof.

- Develop differentiated angles, hooks and test hypotheses that fit the offer and audience.

- Write persuasive ad copy and scripts for short-form video ads and longer video sales letters (VSLs).

- Give editors clear creative briefs: opening visual, scene/shot ideas, on-screen text, pacing, proof and call to action.

- Collaborate with media buyers on priorities and test plans, review actual performance and turn learnings into the next scripts and variations.

- Keep briefs, scripts, versions and next steps organized, and follow through independently from research to creative handoff and iteration.



Your focus is copywriting and creative strategy. Media buyers manage campaigns and video editors handle production; you need to collaborate well with both.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Relevant direct-response copywriting experience for paid ads or affiliate offers, with examples that show your own contribution.

- Strong written English, audience empathy and good judgment about persuasion, positioning and storytelling.

- Experience with nutra, telehealth or money/finance offers is valuable. Tell us which categories and traffic sources you've actually worked on.

- Ability to explain why an angle should work, evaluate evidence and revise it when results disagree.

- Reliable communication, organization and independent follow-through.



You may use AI for research and drafting, but you're responsible for checking sources, improving the work and making the creative decisions. Tool familiarity alone isn't enough.



CLAIMS & COMPLIANCE



Use accurate, supported health and financial claims, appropriate disclosures and creative that fits the offer, market and platform rules. Flag unsupported or restricted claims before production. No fabricated testimonials, results, medical claims or earnings promises.



HOURS & COMPENSATION



- Part-time: 20 hours per week.

- Base pay: US$250–500 per month, depending on experience.

- Additional performance commissions on winning creatives. The definition of a winner, attribution, commission calculation and payment terms will be agreed before starting. Commissions depend on results and are not guaranteed.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with SPARK in uppercase as the very first word, before any greeting. Then answer:



1. Share links to 2–3 relevant ads, scripts or VSLs. For each, describe the audience, offer category, traffic source and exactly what you personally researched, wrote or directed. Clearly label live client/campaign work versus speculative or untested concepts.

2. For one example, explain the research insight, hook and angle. Share results if you're allowed to, with context such as time period, spend, conversion volume, CPA or ROAS, and relevant attribution limits. Distinguish results you personally verified from client/team-reported results or estimates. If results aren't available, say so.

3. Describe your experience with affiliate offers, especially nutra, telehealth or money/finance. How did you check claims and supporting evidence?

4. Give a concrete example of collaborating with a media buyer and an editor. How did campaign feedback change your next script or creative direction?

5. Confirm your availability for 20 hours per week, earliest start date and expected monthly base compensation within the stated range. Briefly explain how you organize research, scripts and handoffs.



Only share work and data you have permission to disclose; redact confidential details. Existing examples are enough for the application. No new unpaid campaign or extensive test project is required.

title: Crypto BD Lead Wanted: Turn DeFi Contacts Into Booked Calls, Get Paid Per Call + Overrides
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: Experienced Video Editor with AI Experience
description:

title: Performance Creative Editor for Meta Ads (Full-Time)
description:
Part-Time Performance Creative Editor, Meta Ads (Full-time) 



Spools makes lightweight, 3D-printed travel mahjong sets, plus chess, backgammon, and poker. We're looking for an unreasonably talented short-form editor to cut ads that sell on Meta. To be clear up front: we're not hiring someone who just edits. We're hiring someone who ships an ad, reads the data that comes back, and iterates. Cut, test, learn, cut again. The edit is half the job. The feedback loop is the other half.



You need to tell a great story through visuals: take raw product and lifestyle footage and turn it into direct-response ads that stop thumbs. Where the footage falls short, you build or source your own supporting assets. You don't wait around for the perfect clip.



Ideally, your edits have real Meta spend behind them, and you can tell us exactly what that spend taught you. You should be able to produce test-ready variations (new hooks, new opens, new pacing, new captions, new CTAs) faster than most competent editors think possible, because you build templates and AI workflows instead of grinding timelines.



Here's who we're looking for:



You're a little obsessed with the numbers. When your ad goes live, you're not done. Hook rate, hold rate, CTR, cost per purchase, ROAS. You read performance data the way you read a timeline, and every number changes your next cut. A winning ad makes you ask why it won and cut six more like it. A dying ad is just creative fatigue, and you already have the refresh queued.



You create lift, not just deliverables. Anyone can make a video look good. You make videos that move CPA.



You're full-circle. You don't just cut what you're handed. You help d
 what gets made: scripts, angles, hooks, AI voiceovers, caption tests, UGC concepts. When we ask "what should we test next," you already have a list.



Strong fundamentals are essential: hooks, retention, storytelling, pacing, captions, motion text. Premiere, Resolve, Final Cut, or CapCut. We don't care which. We care what comes out of it. Graphic design experience is a big plus. And if you play mahjong or board games, even better.



What to expect: You'll work directly with the founder, who handles media buying. You'll get access to real performance data and ownership of the creative testing engine. Your work will be judged by the numbers it produces. We think you'll find that liberating. Expect to be handed real budget, real data, and real ownership of the creative testing engine.



Details:



Flexible schedule, open to part-time or full-time

Independent contractor

Starts with a paid trial of 3 to 5 ads



To apply: Send your portfolio plus one ad you cut that had real spend behind it. Tell us the spend, the results, and what you'd change if you re-cut it today. Then give us one angle you'd want to see Spools try.

title: Content Producer & Short-Form Video Editor — Luxury Beauty + Personal Brand
description:
We’re looking for a high-taste Content Producer and Short-Form Video Editor to create content for two distinct brands:



• A premium permanent makeup and luxury beauty brand

• A founder-led personal brand focused on life, love, identity, confidence, self-worth and personal transformation



This is not simply a video-cutting position.



We need someone who understands:



• Pacing

• Hooks

• Visual storytelling

• Audience retention

• Music and sound selection

• Clean text placement

• Brand identity

• Emotional impact

• What makes people stop scrolling



You should be able to take an approved concept, creative brief and source material and turn them into polished, post-ready content without needing every cut, transition or design choice explained to you.



You will not be responsible for filming or posting content.



Your primary responsibility will be producing and editing high-quality content from footage, images, templates, scripts and creative direction provided by our team.



THE TWO BRANDS



LUXURY BEAUTY BRAND



The beauty brand specializes in premium permanent makeup services.



Its content may include:



• Client transformations

• Before-and-after results

• Permanent brows

• Lip Blush

• Permanent Eyeliner

• Beauty education

• Service storytelling

• Luxury beauty experiences

• Promotional campaigns

• Selected AI-assisted cinematic campaigns



This brand’s content should feel:



• Polished

• Premium

• Clean

• Modern

• Feminine

• Intentional

• Results-focused

• Visually elevated



FOUNDER-LED PERSONAL BRAND



The personal brand focuses on:



• Life

• Love

• Identity

• Self-worth

• Standards and boundaries

• Personal transformation

• Honest storytelling

• Feminine confidence



This brand should feel natural, emotionally engaging and conversational—not overly produced or like a generic influencer page.



The right candidate must understand how to edit these two brands differently without blending their identities.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will produce short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.



Responsibilities may include:



• Reviewing creative briefs and source materials

• Selecting the strongest footage and moments

• Editing face-to-camera videos

• Editing beauty, service, lifestyle and transformation content

• Producing short story-driven videos

• Producing simple graphics and carousels using approved templates

• Creating strong openings and maintaining viewer attention

• Adding approved on-screen text, captions, music and sound effects

• Creating clean transitions and visual flow

• Repurposing strong source material into multiple useful assets when directed

• Using AI tools for selected creative and cinematic projects

• Organizing project files, source assets and final exports

• Following the assigned production queue and deadlines

• Reviewing your own work before submitting it

• Delivering complete, polished work rather than unfinished drafts



You will receive brand direction, creative briefs and priorities. You are expected to use independent editing judgment while remaining within the approved direction.



AI CONTENT EXPERIENCE



Not all content will be AI-generated.



Traditional editing, storytelling and content judgment are the foundation of this position.



However, familiarity with AI creative platforms is strongly preferred because selected campaigns will include AI-assisted imagery and cinematic video production.



Experience with tools such as the following is valuable:



• Higgsfield

• ChatGPT

• Image-generation platforms

• AI video-generation platforms

• CapCut AI tools



If you have produced AI-assisted advertisements, cinematic videos, character-consistent scenes or story-based campaigns, please include examples.



SCHEDULE AND EXPECTED WORK



This is a 20-hour-per-week position:



• 4 hours per day

• 5 days per week

• Monday through Friday



Weekly assignments will vary according to brand priorities and the complexity of each project.



Assignments may include:



• Standard short-form edits

• Face-to-camera videos

• Before-and-after content

• Graphics or carousels

• Campaign assets

• AI-assisted cinematic content



There is no inflexible daily production quota.



A complex AI cinematic assignment may replace several standard edits. We care about strong, useful output—not rushed work created simply to meet a content count.



YOU’RE A STRONG FIT IF YOU:



• Have strong CapCut experience

• Have experience editing TikTok, Reels or YouTube Shorts

• Understand hooks, pacing and viewer retention

• Have strong visual taste and aesthetic judgment

• Can edit both polished brand content and natural personal storytelling

• Can follow creative direction without requiring constant supervision

• Can make thoughtful editing decisions independently

• Know when an edit needs energy and when it needs restraint

• Care about spelling, timing, text placement and small details

• Can organize files and meet deadlines

• Accept feedback professionally

• Learn from revisions and avoid repeating the same mistakes

• Can work efficiently without sacrificing quality

• Communicate clearly and raise questions before they become delays



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



• You require frame-by-frame instructions for every edit

• Your work frequently feels cluttered, chaotic or over-edited

• You use effects and transitions without a clear purpose

• You make every brand look like the same social media template

• You rely on trends without understanding the brand

• You submit unfinished work and expect the company to complete it

• You repeatedly miss details already included in the brief

• You need constant reminders to meet deadlines

• You cannot distinguish between luxury beauty content and authentic personal storytelling

• You depend entirely on AI and lack traditional editing skills



REQUIRED SKILLS



• Strong CapCut experience

• Short-form video editing experience

• Strong understanding of hooks, pacing and retention

• Clean on-screen text and caption placement

• Strong visual storytelling ability

• Excellent attention to detail

• Dependable communication

• Ability to follow brand standards and creative briefs

• Reliable computer and internet connection

• Ability to work independently



PREFERRED SKILLS



• AI video or image-generation experience

• Higgsfield experience

• Beauty, lifestyle or luxury-brand experience

• Face-to-camera and personal-brand editing

• Story-driven or cinematic editing

• Canva experience

• Basic sound design

• Experience managing assignments in Asana or a similar project-management platform



COMPENSATION



• Starting rate: $5–$7 USD per hour

• Final starting rate will be based on demonstrated skill, portfolio quality and paid-trial performance

• 20 hours per week

• 90-day probationary period

• Performance reviews during the probationary period

• Opportunity for increased compensation, hours and responsibility based on demonstrated performance



The starting range will be applied as follows:



• $5/hour — developing candidate with strong potential who requires additional training or direction

• $6/hour — experienced candidate who produces strong traditional edits and requires limited direction

• $7/hour — advanced candidate who demonstrates excellent editing judgment, clear brand distinction, minimal revision needs and strong AI-production ability



Compensation growth will be based on:



• Quality of work

• Consistency

• Dependability

• Speed and efficiency

• Ability to follow direction

• Reduction in unnecessary revisions

• Independent judgment

• Ability to support both brands successfully

• Development and application of AI-production skills



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid trial assignment using our brand materials and direction.



The trial may include:



• One luxury beauty-brand edit

• One personal-brand edit

• A short AI-production exercise or review of your existing AI work



The purpose is to evaluate editing ability, creative judgment, attention to detail and your ability to distinguish between the two brands.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include all of the following:



A link to your three strongest short-form editing samples.



At least one face-to-camera or personal-storytelling sample.



At least one beauty, lifestyle, luxury or transformation-based sample.



Any AI-generated video, image or cinematic work you have created. If you do not have AI samples, state that honestly.



A list of the editing and AI tools you personally know how to use.



Your current availability and the hours you are available to work.



Your internet speed and computer specifications.



For every sample submitted, briefly explain what you personally handled.



Answer the following question in 4–6 sentences:



“How would you make the editing style feel different for a premium beauty-service brand versus an honest, personality-led storytelling brand?”



Begin your application with the words:



“I understand the difference.”



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow into a trusted, long-term creative team member—not someone searching for occasional editing work.

title: UGC & Content Manager
description:
UGC & CONTENT MANAGER (Full-time, remote) — run creator campaigns for a fast-growing kitchen brand



ABOUT US

We are a fast-growing ecommerce company selling premium kitchen products to home cooks in the US, Europe and Australia. We grow mainly through paid video ads, so the people on camera and the content they make are the engine of the business.



THE ROLE

You own our creator content from end to end: who we work with, what they make, and whether it ships. You run our campaigns on Trybe, cast and hire talent on Backstage, brief every creator, get product into their hands fast, review every piece that comes back, and d
 what gets approved, revised or dropped. You also sit with our editors and strategist to work out what content the account needs next and turn that into creator briefs.



The job is half taste and half operations: you know what a great UGC piece looks like before it exists, and you keep thirty conversations moving without one going quiet.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Run our UGC campaigns on Trybe: write the campaign, pick the creators, brief them, chase deliveries, close the loop.

- Cast and hire talent on Backstage for scripted and on-camera roles, from posting to shortlist to booking.

- Learn our marketing inside out: the positioning, the personas, the ad angles that work and why, so every brief you write is relevant to how we sell.

- Write clear creator briefs: the hook, the scenes, the product moments, the do's, with reference ads attached.

- Coordinate with our fulfillment team so product reaches creators within days of signing, and track every shipment until it lands.

- Review every piece of content that comes in. Approve what is right and send clear, specific revision notes on what needs another pass.

- Keep every creator conversation moving: reply the same day, follow up on deadlines before they pass, keep a tracker that shows where every piece stands.

- Work with our editors and strategist each week on what content is missing, which winning ads need new footage, and which new angles need a first attempt.

- Keep an organised library of raw footage and finished pieces so editors find what they need in seconds.



WHAT YOU BRING

- At least 2 years of experience managing UGC creators or influencer content for an ecommerce or DTC brand. Hands-on experience with Trybe, Backstage or similar creator and casting platforms.

- A strong eye for UGC: you can tell a native, believable piece from a scripted ad read, and you can explain the difference to a creator in plain words.

- Excellent written and spoken English. Most of your day is messaging creators, editors and our team, and your messages need to be clear, warm and quick.

- Strong management habits: you keep a tracker, follow up on time and answer every message.

- The ability to understand a brand's marketing, positioning and customer persona quickly and deeply, and to use that understanding in every brief and review.

- Experience giving creators feedback that improves the next take instead of souring the relationship.

- Comfortable working with video editors and understanding what footage they need to cut a good ad.

- Organised, self-driven and comfortable owning outcomes with little supervision.



HOW WE WORK

- Fully remote. Our team is spread across Dubai, Europe and Asia.

- Most of our team is Filipino. There is a team group chat where everyone talks in Tagalog, and it is a warm, welcoming group. You will feel right at home from day one.

- Full-time, 40 hours a week, with at least 4 hours of overlap with Dubai time (GMT+4) each working day.

- Small team, fast decisions. You work directly with the people who make the calls.

- We judge content by one thing: does it make a stranger stop, watch and buy. Everything you approve is measured against that.



SALARY

Based on experience. Tell us your expected monthly rate in USD in your application.



HOW TO APPLY

Send us:

1. Two or three UGC pieces you managed, with a line on your role in each.

2. Every e-commerce DTC brand you have worked with in the past and your role at that brand.

3. Which platforms you have run campaigns on and for how long.

4. Your expected monthly rate and earliest start date.



Lastly, tell me what your favourite animal is and why. This is the most important question of all ;)

title: Direct response Copywriter needed for supplement brand
description:
THIS IS NOT A BEGINNER ROLE.

We're hiring a copywriter whose words sell. You should already have years of direct response experience and a portfolio of copy that has driven real revenue. If you're early in your career or looking to learn on the job, this isn't the right fit. This is a remote role.



ABOUT US

We're a mission-driven health supplement startup focused on habit breaking. We're on pace to do $1M+ per month within the first 90 days. Our customers are people trying to change their behavior and break destructive cycles, and they're hungry for a brand that speaks to them honestly.

We already have the foundation: locked creative angles, sub-angle maps, customer research libraries, and proven winner-iteration workflows. What we need is a great writer to turn all of it into copy that converts.



THE ROLE

You'll be the voice of the brand in our paid ads. Day to day, you'll write video scripts, hooks, headlines, primary text, and long-form copy, then work with our editing team to bring it to life. With significant spend behind you and direct access to performance data, you'll see within days whether your words are working, and you'll use that to write the next round.



WHAT YOU'LL WRITE

* Video ad scripts: UGC, talking-head, and short-form, built for the first three seconds and the full arc

* Hooks and leads: high volume, high variety, every awareness level

* Ad copy: headlines, primary text, and CTAs for Meta

* Long-form: advertorials, landing page copy, and VSL scripts as needed

* Iterations on winners: new hooks, new leads, and new angles that extend what's already working





HOW YOU'LL WORK

* You mine our reviews, post-purchase surveys, and Reddit threads for the exact words customers use, then put those words to work in your copy

* You write 20+ scripts and concepts per week and edit your own work before handoff

* You give editors clear direction and revision notes on every video

* You let new batches run 3-4 days before analyzing results, then write your next round based on what the data shows

* You ask for help when something is unclear and flag problems to your creative lead right away





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

* Years of direct response copywriting experience, ideally in health, wellness, or supplements

* A portfolio of ads, scripts, or long-form copy that has taken meaningful spend

* Mastery of DR fundamentals: awareness levels, big ideas, mechanisms, leads, hooks, proof, and persuasion psychology

* Excellent writing ear: you can write in a real customer's voice, not marketing-speak

* Ability to generate original angles and hooks, not just rework competitors

* Strong self-editing habits and clean, ready-to-produce scripts

* Working knowledge of supplement advertising compliance (Meta policies, FTC guidelines, no disease or unsubstantiated health claims)

* A real connection to the mission of helping people break habits and change behavior





Strongly preferred

* Experience writing video scripts specifically

* Experience writing multiple concepts across different angles at once

* Familiarity with Meta Ad Library and metrics like hook rate, hold rate, CTR, and CPA

* Experience iterating on winners and scaling proven ads





PRACTICAL

* Remote, full-time

* Direct collaboration with editing, media buying, and operations

* Tools: Meta ad account, ClickUp, Google Docs, Figma, Slack

* Access to: customer reviews, survey data, angle briefs, and winning ad performance data





HOW TO APPLY

DM us with:

1. Your portfolio: your best copy, with the angle, the results, and the spend where you can share it

2. Three best-performing pieces: what the angle was, why the copy worked, and what spend it took

3. A writing sample: 5 hooks plus the first 30 seconds of a video script for a habit-breaking supplement (pick any habit)

4. One winner, explained: why you believed the copy would work before it was tested

5. An angle you iterated on: how you took one angle into multiple winning ads

6. Your current workload and availability

7. Why this mission matters to you



We're open to trial periods and letting results d
 how far we take it.

title: AI Website Developer (Bolt.new, Lovable & AI-Assisted Builders)
description:
THE ROLE

You'll redesign and build the new version of our website using AI development platforms like Bolt.new and Lovable, and refine the output with hands-on code and design judgment. We're not looking for someone who just types a prompt and ships whatever comes back. We want a builder who knows how to direct these tools, catch their mistakes, and deliver a site that looks professional, loads fast, and converts visitors into customers.





WHAT YOU'LL DO

1. Plan and scope the rebuild. Review our current site, map out pages and user flows, and propose a structure for the new one.

2. Build with AI tools. Use Bolt.new, Lovable, and similar platforms (v0, Cursor, Replit, Claude Code, and so on) to generate and iterate on the site quickly.

3. Refine and fix. Clean up AI-generated code, fix layout and responsiveness issues, resolve bugs, and make sure the final build is reliable.

4. Optimize for conversion. Build landing pages, product pages, and checkout flows designed to turn traffic into sales.

5. Connect the pieces. Integrate analytics, tracking pixels,
 capture, payments, and any e-commerce platform we use.

6. Launch and maintain. Handle deployment, domain and hosting setup, testing, and post-launch fixes.





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

* Hands-on, proven experience building and shipping real websites with Bolt.new, Lovable, or comparable AI-assisted tools

* A portfolio of live sites you've built (we'll look at them, so make them good)

* Solid fundamentals in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React, enough to edit and debug what the AI produces

* Strong sense of design, layout, typography, and mobile responsiveness

* Experience with prompting techniques that get consistent, high-quality output from AI builders

* Familiarity with deployment and hosting (Netlify, Vercel, GitHub, or similar)

* Working knowledge of site performance and SEO basics (page speed, metadata, image optimization)

* Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and meet deadlines





Strongly preferred

* Experience building e-commerce or direct-to-consumer sites (Shopify, Stripe, headless setups)

* Experience with conversion rate optimization and landing page best practices

* Familiarity with Supabase or similar backends for forms, auth, and databases

* Experience integrating tracking tools (Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, GTM)

* Familiarity with Figma and the ability to work from a design reference

* Experience migrating an existing site without losing SEO rankings





HOW WE'LL WORK TOGETHER

* You'll get clear goals, brand assets, and access to the current site

* You'll share working previews early and often, not just a finished product at the end

* You'll tell us when a tool can't do something well and recommend a better approach rather than forcing it

* You'll document how the site is built so we can maintain or hand it off later





HOW TO APPLY

Send us:

1. Your portfolio: links to 3-5 live sites you've built with AI-assisted tools

2. Your process: which tool you'd use for this project and why, and how you'd handle the parts AI builders tend to get wrong

3. A quick example: a before-and-after or short walkthrough of a project where you had to fix or improve AI-generated output

4. Your availability and rate

5. Anything else we should know





We're open to a paid trial project before committing to the full build.

title: Outbound Sales & Email Outreach Assistant

Send personalized
s introducing our product.

s that don't sound automated.
