title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor & Brand & PR Outreach



I’m looking for someone who can become the **behind-the-scenes brain of my content operation** — someone who understands social media, moves quickly, knows what is trending before everyone else does, and can help turn raw footage into content that actually performs.



This is not just a video editing job.



I need someone who can edit content, identify trends, keep me on a consistent posting schedule, experiment with new formats, and help me find opportunities with brands and PR teams.



Think of yourself as part video editor, social media strategist, content manager, and PR detective.



What You'll Do





Edit a mix of short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Trial Reels.



The content will range from:



* Highly edited, storytelling-driven Reels

* Talking-head and voiceover videos

* Travel, food, fashion, lifestyle, and brand content

* Fast, trend-based videos

* Simple 5-minute edits that may literally be a trending quote, sound, text overlay, or relatable moment

* Repurposing existing footage into new pieces of content

* Creating multiple variations of a Reel to test different hooks



Important: Not every video needs to be a cinematic masterpiece.



Sometimes I need a highly produced Reel with transitions, captions, pacing, sound design, and storytelling.



Other times, I need someone to recognize, *“This trend is perfect — let's throw this footage together and get it posted today.”*



You need to know the difference.



You should be **obsessed with what's happening on social media.**



I need someone who:



* Finds trending sounds, formats, hooks, memes, quotes, and editing styles

* Understands what is currently working on Instagram and TikTok

* Keeps up with emerging trends rather than discovering them two weeks later

* Identifies trends that fit my personality, audience, and niche

* Suggests content ideas proactively

* Finds opportunities for Trial Reels

* Creates Trial Reel variations for testing

* Understands hooks, retention, pacing, and shareability

* Is constantly asking: **“How can we make this perform better?”**



I don't want someone who waits for me to tell them what to edit.



I want someone who can come to me and say:



“I found this trend. Here's how we can make it yours.”



Content Management & Deadlines



I need someone who can help keep the content pipeline moving.



Responsibilities include:



* Organizing raw footage

* Tracking what needs to be edited

* Creating a realistic editing/posting timeline

* Making sure content is delivered on time

* Keeping track of brand deadlines

* Flagging anything that needs my approval

* Making sure we are consistently testing new content

* Helping maintain a backlog of ready-to-post content



Basically, I should **not** have to chase you to ask where a video is.



You should be the person saying:



**“These three videos are ready, this one needs your voiceover, and we have two Trial Reels going out tomorrow.”**



Brand & PR Outreach



This is the part that makes the role different.



I also want someone who can help me find the people behind the brands.



You don't need to be a traditional PR professional but you should be extremely resourceful.



I want someone who can:



* Find brand partnership
s

* Find PR and influencer marketing contacts

* Research who handles creator partnerships for a brand

* Find relevant people on LinkedIn

* Identify PR agencies representing brands

* Find the right marketing/PR/creator contact rather than sending
s into a generic inbox

* Help build targeted brand lists

* Track outreach and follow-ups

* Identify brands that would genuinely make sense for my content

* Help pitch brands through LinkedIn when appropriate

* Find events, launches, openings, travel opportunities, and creator campaigns

* Think creatively about **who we should be talking to and how we can get in the door**



I jokingly call this the “PR spy” part of the job.



If I say:



 “I want to work with this brand.”



I don't want the answer to be:



 “Here's their contact page.”



I want:



 “I found their influencer marketing person, the PR agency they work with, the relevant LinkedIn contacts, and three people we should reach out to.”



You should be a detective.





You would be a great fit if you:



* Live on Instagram and TikTok

* Actually understand internet culture

* Know trends before they become completely oversaturated

* Have strong editing skills

* Can edit quickly without sacrificing quality

* Have a good eye for pacing and storytelling

* Understand what makes people stop scrolling

* Are proactive rather than waiting for instructions

* Are highly organized

* Are comfortable working with deadlines

* Are resourceful and good at research

* Know how to use LinkedIn strategically

* Are comfortable finding people and information online

* Have strong written communication skills

* Can identify good brand opportunities

* Have a strong understanding of influencer marketing and PR

* Are willing to experiment and test things

* Can tell the difference between something that is actually a trend and something that was trending three months ago 😭



## Bonus Points If You Have



* Experience editing Instagram Reels/TikToks

* Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar

* Experience managing a creator's content calendar

* Experience with Trial Reels

* Experience working with influencers/creators

* Experience in influencer marketing or PR

* Experience finding brand/PR contacts

* Experience with LinkedIn outreach

* Understanding of paid social/whitelisting

* Strong knowledge of NYC lifestyle, food, fashion, travel, and beauty content

* A portfolio or examples of social content you've helped grow





After a few weeks, I want to feel like I have another brain working behind the scenes.



You see a trend → you flag it.



You see a great opportunity → you send it to me.



You know a video needs to go out → you make sure it happens.



You find a brand I should work with → you find the person who can actually get me in the room.



You notice a Reel isn't performing → you think about why and suggest another approach.



You don't just execute instructions.



You think with me.



If you're someone who genuinely loves social media, moves quickly, is naturally curious, and gets a little too excited about finding the *right* PR contact at a brand, I want to hear from you.

title: Static Ad Editor – 8 Figure DTC Brand
description:
We are looking for a highly creative Static Ad Editor who understands direct response advertising and can create high-performing static ads for Meta.



This role is not just about making ads look good. You need to understand why an ad works, how to match the creative to the customer’s awareness level, and how to write clear, direct, emotionally relevant copy that makes someone stop scrolling.



You will be responsible for creating static image ads from concept to final design, including the headline, supporting copy, layout, image direction, and overall creative execution.

- Write your own ad copy, including hooks, headlines, sub-headlines, callouts, and supporting text

- Understand and apply the 3 key customer awareness levels when creating ads:

   - Trigger Awareness: The customer is feeling a problem but may not fully understand what is causing it yet

   - Exploration Awareness: The customer is actively looking for answers, explanations, or possible solutions

   - Evaluation Awareness: The customer understands the problem and is comparing products, mechanisms, benefits, or offers

- Create ads that match the customer’s current mindset instead of using generic headlines

- Turn creative briefs, customer research, and product angles into strong static ad concepts

- Work with the creative team to test new hooks, visual formats, angles, and messaging styles

- Experience creating static ads for eCommerce, DTC, supplements, wellness, beauty, or similar direct response brands

- We want someone who can think like a creative strategist, write like a direct response marketer, and design like a performance-focused editor.

title: Email Deliverability & Reputation Specialist | Cold Email Infrastructure
description:
About the job

The role in brief: A remote, part-time position keeping a cold
 engine's accounts and mailboxes healthy and landing in the inbox. The most valuable quality is catching problems early, before a small signal (a slight bounce increase, a DNS error, a warm-up dip) turns into a blacklisted domain or a burned mailbox. With limited hours, that means a short, focused routine rather than constant watching.



Anticipating issues before they escalate (the core of the role)



Early warning signs to watch

- Bounce rate creeping up, even slightly, which often points to list quality or authentication problems

- Spam complaints or spam folder placement rising week over week

- Warm-up score drops or mailboxes that have paused or disconnected in Smartlead

- Google Postmaster Tools reputation or spam rate slipping before it hits "low"

- Blacklist appearances on domains or IPs, caught on the first listing

- DNS drift, such as changed or broken SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, or CNAME records, or SOA values going out of spec

- Reply forwarding failures, so replies aren't silently lost



A routine that works on part-time hours

- Short daily check: mailbox connection status, warm-up activity, bounces, complaints, and blacklist scans (MXToolbox)

- Weekly audit: full SPF/DKIM/DMARC validation, SOA serial number and expire value, SMTP health, and inbox placement tests (GlockApps, Mail-Tester, SpamAssassin, Smartlead Deliverability)

- Alerts where possible: use Smartlead and Postmaster notifications so problems come to you between checks

- Trend tracking: compare each week to the last so slow declines get noticed, not just sudden failures

- Contain quickly: pause the affected mailbox or campaign, fix the cause, and protect the rest of the sending infrastructure

- Root cause first: find out why it happened (template, list, DNS, volume) so it doesn't repeat



Maintaining accounts and mailboxes

- Manage mailboxes through Zapmail, with IMAP and SMTP enabled and connected to Smartlead

- Manage domains and DNS in GoDaddy (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, and CNAME for custom tracking domains)

- Keep warm-up running and filtering and forwarding working

- Track reputation with Google Postmaster Tools, Sender Score, and Microsoft SNDS

- Resolve blacklistings and spam complaints promptly



Spam diagnosis on active campaigns

- Review live Smartlead campaigns for spam scores, bounces, spam reports, blacklist status, and ESP IP reputation

- Flag spam triggers (spammy words, too many links, poor HTML) to the team and recommend template and sending fixes before campaigns scale up



Supporting responsibilities

- Monthly expansion: Create 15 new mailboxes and set up 5 new domains, then connect them to Smartlead with warm-up on. New setups are a common source of errors, so verify them before they send.

- Reporting: Weekly reports on audit results, reputation status, changes made, and risks spotted early, with recommendations for marketing and management.



Requirements/Must have:

- Experience in
 deliverability, spam filtering, or cold outreach

- Strong knowledge of SPF, DKIM, and DMARC

- Familiarity with the deliverability tools above

- Understanding of CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CASL

- Analytical, detail-oriented, and good at spotting patterns



Nice to have:

Smartlead experience

Technical knowledge of
 servers, IP warm-up, and domain reputation management



If you do not have the experience on the Requirements/Must have above, please do not apply

title: Direct-Response Copywriter | $1,500/mo Full-Time or $750/mo Part-Time + Per-Brand Bonus
description:
You know who Harry Dry is. You have studied Eugene Schwartz, Gary Halbert, and the copywriters whose work still gets passed around decades later.



You have taken the courses, broken down the ads, filled notebooks with ideas, and trained your eye to notice why one line works while another dies.



But now you are wondering where all that effort leads.



AI is making average writing cheaper. SEO articles, generic social captions, and basic blog posts are becoming commodities. You do not want to spend the next five years becoming faster at work that is becoming less valuable.



Good. Neither do we.



We are looking for a high-potential direct-response copywriter who is already unusually good, deeply hungry, and ready to turn theory into a serious commercial skill.



This is not an entry-level role for someone who has just discovered copywriting. It is for someone with strong fundamentals, real obsession, and enough humility to keep learning fast.



THE PAY



✅ Full-time: $1,500 USD per month

✅ Part-time: $750 USD per month

✅ Plus a bonus of ₱10,000 to ₱25,000 extra per month for every brand you handle, depending on the brand. The bonus starts once you have proven yourself and are successfully managing your first 3 to 5 brands. The more brands you carry, the more you earn on top of your base.



We start with a paid test. You get paid for the test work, and if it goes well, you move into the full role.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



You will help us develop direct-response creative for multiple seven- and eight-figure brands.



That means you will:



• Research customers, markets, competitors, and winning ads

• Find sharp angles, hooks, mechanisms, and offers

• Write scripts for paid-social video ads

• Develop static-ad concepts and supporting copy

• Turn customer psychology into creative strategy

• Work with designers and editors to bring ideas to life

• Study performance data and learn why ads win or lose

• Improve your work through direct, detailed feedback



You will not spend your days writing filler articles to hit a keyword count. You will learn how to engineer creative that earns attention, changes belief, and gets people to buy.



That is one of the highest-leverage skills a copywriter can build.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a fit if:



• You have seriously studied direct-response copywriting

• You are familiar with people like Harry Dry, Eugene Schwartz, and Gary Halbert

• You have written ads, scripts,
s, landing pages, or other conversion-focused work

• You can explain why a piece of copy works, not just whether you like it

• You actively collect examples, take courses, read books, and break down winning creative

• You are comfortable receiving blunt, specific feedback

• You care about performance more than sounding clever

• You are resourceful, reliable, and able to work independently

• You want steep growth, real responsibility, and work that matters



You do not need ten years of experience. You do need evidence that you have already taken this craft seriously.



WHAT ELSE YOU GET



• Remote work

• Hands-on experience with multiple seven- and eight-figure brands

• Direct exposure to creative strategy, paid-social advertising, design, and performance analysis

• Fast feedback and a high standard that will make you better

• A path beyond being "just a writer"

• The chance to build a skill set that becomes more valuable as generic writing becomes cheaper



AI is not replacing great direct-response thinkers. It is replacing average output.



If you learn how to understand markets, uncover desire, build persuasive arguments, and turn those insights into ads that make money, you become far more valuable than someone who simply produces more words.



That is what we want to help you become.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word "HALBERT" so we know you read this far. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



Then send us:



1. Whether you want full-time or part-time

2. A short introduction explaining why this role fits you

3. Two or three examples of your strongest work

4. One ad you think is brilliant and a short explanation of why it works

5. The names of the copywriting books, courses, or creators that have influenced you most



If you are hungry, already dangerous, and still feel like you have everything to prove, we want to hear from you.

title: E-Commerce Shopify Creative and CRO
description:
Shopify CRO & E-Commerce



About Hone Aroma

Hone Aroma is a fast-growing Singapore home fragrance e-commerce brand specialising in cold air diffusers and premium aroma oils.



Our mission is simple:

Turn your home into a 5-star hotel.

We sell through our own Shopify store as well as major marketplaces including Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop. We are growing across Singapore and Malaysia and are looking for a creative, detail-oriented specialist to help us improve how our products are presented and converted online.



________________________________________

JOB OVERVIEW

We are looking for a Shopify CRO & E-Commerce Creative Specialist who combines strong visual design skills with a practical understanding of e-commerce conversion optimization.

This is a specialised role.

Your primary responsibility will be to make our online stores look better, communicate our value more clearly, and convert more visitors into customers.

You will work closely with the founder to continuously improve:

• Shopify storefront design and conversion rate

• Product pages and landing pages

• Shopee storefronts and product listings

• Lazada storefronts and product listings

• TikTok Shop storefronts

• Meta advertising creatives

• Product presentation and visual merchandising

You should be someone who understands that good e-commerce design isn't simply about making something look beautiful.

It needs to answer:

Does this catch attention?

Does this communicate the product clearly?

Does this build trust?

Does this make the customer want to buy?



________________________________________

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Shopify CRO & Website Design — PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY

Take ownership of continuously improving the Hone Aroma Shopify store.

Responsibilities include:

• Design and modify Shopify pages and sections

• Edit Shopify themes and layouts

• Improve product page structure and visual hierarchy

• Improve mobile shopping experience

• Design landing pages for campaigns and promotions

• Improve product descriptions and visual communication

• Identify conversion barriers and propose solutions

• Conduct CRO audits

• Create and implement A/B tests where appropriate

• Analyse customer behaviour and website performance

• Improve navigation, merchandising and product discovery and checkout

• Continuously test different layouts, offers, messaging and visual elements

You should be comfortable making changes directly inside Shopify rather than simply providing design files for someone else to implement.

Example of the type of thinking we want:

Instead of:

"The product page could look nicer."

We want:

"The product benefits are too far below the fold on mobile. I would move the key benefits and social proof higher, reduce the amount of text, and test this against the current layout."



________________________________________

2. Shopee, Lazada & TikTok Shop Storefront Design

You will be responsible for improving how Hone Aroma is presented across marketplace platforms.

Responsibilities include:

• Design Shopee storefronts

• Design Lazada storefronts

• Design TikTok Shop storefronts

• Design marketplace product listing images

• Create product image sequences that communicate benefits and features

• Improve marketplace visual merchandising

• Create promotional banners and campaign graphics

• Design category/collection visuals

• Maintain consistent Hone Aroma branding across marketplaces

• Adapt creative assets to each platform's requirements

You should understand that marketplace shoppers behave differently from Shopify customers and know how to structure visuals to communicate product value quickly.



________________________________________

3. Meta Advertising Creative

Create high-quality static image advertisements for Hone Aroma's paid advertising campaigns.

Responsibilities include:

• Create Meta/Facebook/Instagram image ads

• Develop different creative concepts and hooks

• Create multiple variations for testing

• Adapt existing product photography into advertising creatives

• Design promotional creatives

• Create testimonial/review-based advertisements

• Create problem/solution advertisements

• Create product benefit advertisements

• Analyse existing ad creatives and identify opportunities for improvement

• Work with the founder to continuously test new creative angles

The goal is not simply to create attractive graphics.

The goal is to create advertising creatives that generate attention and sales.

You should understand concepts such as:

• Hook

• Visual hierarchy

• Offer presentation

• Social proof

• Product benefits

• CTA

• Creative fatigue

• Creative testing



________________________________________

4. Creative Testing & Optimization

We operate according to:

Test → Learn → Improve → Scale

You will be expected to continuously create and test new creative ideas.

For example:

• Different headlines

• Different product angles

• Different layouts

• Different images

• Different hooks

• Different offers

• Different customer pain points

• Different visual styles

• Different product benefits

You will maintain a structured creative testing library so we know:

What was tested → Why it was tested → What happened → What we learned



________________________________________

5. E-Commerce Visual Merchandising

Ensure that Hone Aroma's products are presented consistently across all customer touchpoints.

This includes:

• Shopify

• Shopee

• Lazada

• TikTok Shop

• Meta advertisements

• Promotional campaigns

• Product launches

• Product pages

• Marketplace listings

You will help maintain a premium, modern and consistent Hone Aroma visual identity.



________________________________________

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS

Shopify

• 2+ years of experience working with Shopify

• Hands-on experience editing Shopify themes and storefronts

• Experience modifying layouts, sections and product pages

• Strong understanding of Shopify e-commerce UX

• Understanding of conversion rate optimization

• Able to implement website design changes independently

E-Commerce Design

• 2+ years of design experience

• Strong Canva proficiency

• Strong understanding of e-commerce product imagery

• Experience designing product listing images

• Experience creating marketplace storefronts

• Experience with Shopee, Lazada or TikTok Shop

• Strong understanding of visual hierarchy and product communication

Meta Advertising Creative

• Experience creating static image advertisements for Meta Ads

• Understanding of what makes an effective performance marketing creative

• Able to create multiple creative concepts and variations

• Comfortable designing for both mobile feeds and Stories/Reels placements

General

• Excellent written English

• Strong attention to detail

• Strong visual/design judgement

• Good understanding of e-commerce customer psychology

• Able to work independently

• Comfortable receiving feedback and rapidly iterating

• Proficient with Google Drive / Google Sheets

• Stable internet connection

• Professional computer/workstation

• Webcam for video calls



________________________________________

BONUS SKILLS

These are not required, but would be a strong advantage:

AI Image Generation

Experience with tools such as:

• Holo.ai

• Midjourney

• DALL-E

• Stable Diffusion

• Other AI image generation/editing platforms

You should be able to use AI as a creative production tool, rather than simply generating random images.

Product Design

Experience with:

• Consumer product design

• Packaging design

• Product development

• 3D product visualisation

• CAD or similar tools

This would be particularly valuable as Hone Aroma continues developing new products.

Other

• Adobe Photoshop

• Figma

• CapCut

• Basic HTML/CSS

• Basic Liquid

• Experience with Google Analytics

• Experience with Shopify analytics

• Experience with Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity or similar tools



________________________________________

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Your job is not simply to complete design requests.

You will be expected to actively identify opportunities to improve Hone Aroma's online conversion and presentation.

For example:

Before:

"Here is the new product image you asked for."

What we want:

"I noticed our competitors communicate coverage area before product specifications. I created two alternative product-image layouts and recommend testing them on the Pillar product page."

You should constantly be asking:

"How can we make this clearer, more compelling and more likely to convert?"



________________________________________

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Your performance will be measured through both execution and measurable improvements.

Examples include:

Shopify CRO

• Number of CRO tests implemented

• Product page improvements

• Landing page improvements

• Mobile UX improvements

• Conversion rate improvements

• Revenue per visitor improvements

Marketplace

• Storefront redesigns completed

• Product listing improvements

• Creative assets produced

• Marketplace conversion improvements

• Marketplace sales performance

Meta Creative

• Number of new creative concepts produced

• Number of creative tests launched

• CTR improvement

• CPA/CAC improvement

• Identification of winning creative concepts

Execution

• Projects completed on time

• Quality of work

• Attention to detail

• Ability to work independently

• Ability to respond to feedback and iterate quickly



________________________________________

OUR WORKING PHILOSOPHY

We don't believe in designing something once and leaving it untouched.

Our philosophy is:

Test → Learn → Improve → Scale

If something works, we scale it.

If something doesn't work, we learn from it.

If you see something that can be improved, we expect you to speak up and propose a solution.



________________________________________

WHAT YOU'LL GET

• Full-time remote position with a Singapore-based company

• Direct working relationship with the Founder

• High level of ownership over Hone Aroma's e-commerce presentation

• Opportunity to work across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop and Meta

• Opportunity to build a portfolio of real e-commerce work

• Stable, long-term position for the right candidate

• Performance-based compensation growth

• Opportunity to take on greater responsibility as the company scales

• 7 days paid annual leave

________________________________________

WORKING HOURS

Remote Full-time — 40 hours/week

Singapore Time (GMT+8)

Start Date: ASAP



________________________________________

APPLICATION PROCESS



We want to see what you can actually do, rather than simply read your resume.



Step 1 — Online Application Quiz

Approximately 20 minutes to complete the quiz.

Link to quiz: 



You will provide information about your experience, how you think, and skills you have.



Step 2 — Skills / Mock Scenario + Mandatory Video Recording

Approximately 30 minutes.

You may be asked to:

• Identify CRO improvements on a Shopify product page

• Create a sample Meta advertisement

• Improve an e-commerce product image

• Explain how you would redesign a marketplace storefront

• Explain your reasoning behind your design and CRO decisions



🎥 Mandatory Video Recording

As part of Step 2, you must submit a short video recording of yourself, no longer than 2–3 minutes.

Applications without the required video recording will not proceed to the next stage.

In your video, please cover:

1. Tell us about yourself

Give us a brief introduction and explain your relevant experience.

2. Explain your mock scenario thinking

Walk us through how you approached the mock scenario:



We are more interested in how you think than in giving us a perfect answer.

Please record the video naturally. No professional production or editing is required. A simple webcam or phone recording is perfectly fine.



Step 3 — 1-on-1 Video Interview

Approximately 20 minutes.

Candidates who progress to this stage will have a direct conversation with the Founder about their experience, working style and potential fit with the role.



________________________________________

APPLICATION KEYWORD

Please include the word:

"SCALE"

in your application subject line or message.

This lets us know that you have read the complete job description.

description:
Hyrly is hiring a reliable, phone-confident Lead Follow-Up & Customer Service VA to turn incoming service inquiries into qualified leads and confirmed bookings.



SCHEDULE AND PAY

Remote: Monday-Friday, 5-8 hours/day (25-40 hours/week), with the exact schedule agreed before hiring.

Compensation: US$2.50–$3.00/hour.

TIME ZONE AND AVAILABILITY

This is a live customer-facing role requiring availability during the agreed U.S. business hours. For applicants in the Philippines, this may mean evening or overnight work and finishing on the next calendar day.



For reference, Philippine time (PHT, UTC+8) is 12 hours ahead of U.S. Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) and 13 hours ahead of Eastern Standard Time (EST). For example, 9:00 a.m. Eastern is 9:00 p.m. in the Philippines during EDT and 10:00 p.m. during EST. The Philippines does not change clocks for daylight saving time, so a fixed Eastern-time shift moves by one hour in Philippine local time when U.S. clocks change.



The exact U.S. time zone, start/end times, and daily hours will be confirmed before hiring. Please state your availability in both Philippine time and U.S. Eastern time and confirm whether you can work evenings/overnights and accommodate seasonal time changes.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Answer incoming calls and promptly return missed calls.

- Contact new website,
, and Google leads by phone and text.

- Respond to SMS,
 messages,
, and CRM conversations during your shift.

- Ask qualification questions about the service, location, job size, requested date, and special requirements.

- Share approved pricing and send quote, booking, and payment links.

You will use approved information and pricing. You will not independently change prices, issue refunds, or make unapproved promises.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Clear spoken and written English and confidence making and answering phone calls.

- Strong listening, customer service, follow-up, and organizational skills.

- Reliable internet, a suitable computer, a working headset, and a quiet workspace.

- Availability for an agreed 5-8-hour shift each Monday-Friday, with reliable attendance throughout the shift.

- Ability to follow scripts, maintain accurate records, and ask for help when needed.

- Customer service or sales experience is helpful. GoHighLevel and Slack experience are a plus.



HOW TO APPLY

title: Outbound Caller / Sales & Interview Agent – US Market
description:
We are looking for a confident and reliable English speaking Outbound Caller / Sales and Interview Agent to join our team long term.



You will be calling businesses and individuals in the United States using our company provided calling system.



This is not a position where you simply read a script. We are looking for someone who can speak naturally, listen carefully, ask questions, handle objections, and make the person on the other end feel comfortable talking to you.



Depending on the campaign, calls may involve:



- Conducting short phone interviews

- Asking structured questions and recording responses

- Qualifying potential customers

- Explaining a service in simple terms

- Following up with interested prospects

- Setting appointments

- Handling objections

- Accurately updating call results and notes in our system



ENGLISH REQUIREMENT



You must have native or near native English speaking and listening ability, especially for conversations with US customers.



You should be able to:



- Speak fluently and naturally without struggling to find words

- Understand fast and conversational American English

- Respond naturally when a conversation goes off script

- Communicate clearly without customers regularly asking you to repeat yourself

- Maintain a professional, confident, friendly, and natural tone

- Understand common US expressions, phrasing, and conversational styles



A perfect American accent is not required, but your spoken English must be highly fluent, clear, natural, and easy for US customers to understand.



Candidates with previous experience speaking daily with US customers are strongly preferred.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Native or near native spoken English

- Excellent listening comprehension

- Clear and easy to understand pronunciation

- Confidence speaking with US customers

- Strong conversational skills

- Reliable attendance and communication

- Stable internet connection

- Quiet working environment

- Ability to follow a process without sounding robotic

- Good computer skills

- Accurate data entry



Previous experience in any of the following is strongly preferred:



- BPO or call center

- Cold calling

- Appointment setting

- Outbound sales

- Lead qualification

- Customer service

- Phone interviewing

- Market research



COMPENSATION



- $5 to $7 USD per hour depending on experience and performance

- Additional performance bonuses depending on the campaign and results

- All trial work is paid

- Opportunities for increased base pay based on performance

- More hours and additional responsibilities available for strong performers

- Long term opportunity for the right candidates



We are looking for people we can continue working with long term, not temporary freelancers for a few days.



SCHEDULE



- Approximately 30 to 40 hours per week

- You must be comfortable working hours that overlap with normal US business hours

- Exact schedule will be agreed upon before hiring



EQUIPMENT



We provide:



- Leads

- Calling system

- US phone numbers

- Scripts and call guidelines

- Training

- CRM or data entry system



You will need:



- Reliable computer

- Good quality headset

- Stable internet connection

- Quiet place to make calls

- Backup internet connection strongly preferred



HOW TO APPLY



Please read these instructions carefully.



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be reviewed.



Start the first line of your application with the word ORANGE.



Then include:



- Your name and location in the Philippines

- Your expected hourly rate

- Your previous outbound calling, BPO, or sales experience

- The types of calls you have made in previous positions

- Approximately how many outbound calls you were making per day

- Whether you are currently working for another employer or client

- The hours you currently work for any other employer or client

- Your internet speed

- Whether you have backup internet

- How many years you have spent regularly speaking with US customers



VOICE RECORDING REQUIRED



Please include a 60 to 90 second unedited voice recording.



In the recording, naturally answer:



- Tell us briefly about your previous phone, BPO, or sales experience

- Imagine you call someone and they immediately say, "I'm busy, I'm not interested." What would you say?

- Why do you think you would be good at speaking with US customers?



Please do not use AI generated audio or heavily edited recordings.



We care much more about how naturally you communicate than whether you give the perfect answer.



HIRING PROCESS



Candidates who pass the initial screening will go through:



- Application review

- Voice recording review

- Short video interview

- Live call role play

- Paid trial



During the role play, we may give you responses such as:



- "I'm not interested."

- "I'm busy."

- "What is this about?"

- "How did you get my number?"

- "Send me information."

- "How much does it cost?"



We are looking for people who can remain calm, understand the other person immediately, think naturally, and continue the conversation without sounding aggressive or robotic.



Final candidates will complete a short paid trial using our real system and training process.



We measure performance based on call quality and results, not simply the number of hours you appear online.



If you have native or near native English fluency, are reliable, comfortable on the phone, and interested in building a long term position with a growing company, we would like to hear from you.

title: Construction Accountant and Project Coordinator (Full-Cycle Bookkeeping + Project Management)
description:
Job Title

Construction Accountant and Project Coordinator (Full-Cycle Bookkeeping + Project Management)



Type of Work

Full Time



Salary

$4 – $8 USD per hour, based on experience



Hours

40 hours per week. At least 4 hours must overlap with US Central Time business hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CT) so you can reach clients and subcontractors during their workday.



Job Overview



We are a US accounting firm that works with small construction contractors. Most of our clients are owner-operators without an office team. Some use software like ServiceTitan or JobTread, some use their own custom systems, and some use spreadsheets or nothing at all.



We are hiring one person to act as the project manager and accounting point of contact for a group of these contractors. You will track their jobs, keep their schedules organized, monitor employee time, communicate with the contractor and their subcontractors, and make sure every project cost is billed and collected. You will be the link between our accountants in the office and the people in the field.



Many of these contractors do not have good systems in place. You will help us build and improve processes for the clients who need guidance.



When a client has no active projects to manage, you will handle their regular monthly bookkeeping and task tracking.



What You Will Do



Project management and coordination



-Track projects, schedules, and work status in each client's system (ServiceTitan, JobTread, custom software, or spreadsheets)

-Schedule work and follow up with clients and subcontractors by
 and text

-Keep our accounting team updated on job progress, change orders, and completed work

-Keep task lists current so nothing is missed



Employee time tracking



-Review employee clock-ins and clock-outs

-Confirm employees are clocking into the correct project

-Follow up with the client or employee to correct errors before payroll and job costing are finalized



Accounts receivable



-Review all project costs and confirm they are billable and invoiced to the customer

-Prepare and send invoices in the format each client prefers, based on work completed

-Handle progress billing, change orders, and retainage where they apply

-Follow up on unpaid invoices and collect payment



Accounts payable



-Collect and enter subcontractor and vendor bills

-Match bills to the correct job and confirm work was completed before payment

-Collect lien waivers (conditional and unconditional) before and after payment

-Collect W-9s and track 1099 vendors throughout the year



Job costing and bookkeeping



-Track labor, materials, and subcontractor costs by project

-Flag jobs going over budget and costs that have not been billed

-Code transactions and reconcile bank and credit card accounts in QuickBooks Online

-Complete monthly bookkeeping and close for clients without active projects

-Keep client files organized and complete



Process improvement



-Identify gaps in how each client tracks jobs, time, costs, and billing

-Help create and document processes for clients who need guidance

-Recommend improvements to our firm's workflows as you learn what works



Tools You Will Use



Our firm: Canopy, Google Workspace, Double, QuickBooks Online, Ramp, Quo (calls and texting)

Our clients: ServiceTitan, JobTread, custom software, and spreadsheets



Requirements

3+ years of full-cycle bookkeeping or accounting experience



Strong QuickBooks Online experience

Construction accounting experience: job costing, progress billing, retainage, lien waivers, and 1099 tracking

Project management or project coordination experience

Experience reviewing employee timesheets or time tracking data

Excellent written and spoken English. You will be texting and
ing US contractors and subcontractors directly.

Comfortable following up with people until you get what you need

Able to work on your own and manage multiple clients at once

Reliable internet connection and a quiet work space



Preferred



Experience with the American wood framing construction process (foundation, framing, trusses, sheathing, rough-ins, inspections, and finish work)

Experience with ServiceTitan, JobTread, or similar field service software

Experience creating or documenting business processes

Experience working with US small businesses

Accounting degree or bookkeeping certification



How to Apply



Send your resume and answer the questions below in your application. Put "Construction PM" in the subject line. 



Applications without the subject line or without answers to the questions will not be reviewed.



Describe your construction accounting experience. What types of contractors did you work with, and what tasks did you handle?

Which of these tools have you used, and for how long: QuickBooks Online, ServiceTitan, JobTread, Canopy, Ramp?



A subcontractor sends a bill for completed framing work and wants to be paid this week. What do you collect and confirm before the payment is released?

A client has not answered your last two
s about an unpaid invoice. What do you do next?

description:
We are looking for a highly creative Static Ad Editor who understands direct response advertising and can create high-performing static ads for Meta.



This role is not just about making ads look good. You need to understand why an ad works, how to match the creative to the customer’s awareness level, and how to write clear, direct, emotionally relevant copy that makes someone stop scrolling.



You will be responsible for creating static image ads from concept to final design, including the headline, supporting copy, layout, image direction, and overall creative execution.



>>>Responsibilities:

- Create static ads for Meta that are designed to drive clicks, conversions, and profitable customer acquisition

- Develop new ad concepts based on customer pain points, emotions, product benefits, and proven direct response angles

- Write your own ad copy, including hooks, headlines, sub-headlines, callouts, and supporting text

- Understand and apply the 3 key customer awareness levels when creating ads:

   - Trigger Awareness: The customer is feeling a problem but may not fully understand what is causing it yet

   - Exploration Awareness: The customer is actively looking for answers, explanations, or possible solutions

   - Evaluation Awareness: The customer understands the problem and is comparing products, mechanisms, benefits, or offers

- Create ads that match the customer’s current mindset instead of using generic headlines

- Turn creative briefs, customer research, and product angles into strong static ad concepts

- Work with the creative team to test new hooks, visual formats, angles, and messaging styles

- Analyze winning ads and understand the creative strategy behind them

- Create variations of winning concepts without simply copying the same ad repeatedly

- Ensure the final static ads are clean, easy to read, visually strong, and aligned with the brand

- Balance strong direct response messaging with tasteful, compliant, and brand-appropriate execution



>>>Requirements:

- Experience creating static ads for eCommerce, DTC, supplements, wellness, beauty, or similar direct response brands

- Strong understanding of Meta ads and what makes someone stop scrolling

- Ability to write clear, compelling ad copy without relying on a copywriter for every concept

- Strong understanding of customer awareness levels and how messaging changes at each stage

- Ability to create ads that speak directly to customer problems, desires, objections, and emotions

- Investors purchasing or preparing new short-term rentals

- Owners who want better revenue, operations and guest management

- Owners with one property or multiple properties



Our initial target market is **Bexar County and the greater San Antonio area**, including communities north of San Antonio.



We also have the ability to expand our marketing toward **New Braunfels, the I-35 corridor and Austin** as campaigns develop.



## WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



You will help build and manage Casa Rentals' paid lead-generation strategy, primarily through Meta/Facebook/Instagram.



Responsibilities include:



- Creating and managing Meta Ads campaigns

- Geographic and demographic targeting

- Audience research

- Developing different audience segments

- Creating ad copy and marketing hooks

- Creating ad graphics and basic video/Reel creative

- Developing Meta Instant Lead Forms

- Creating qualification questions within lead forms

- A/B testing creative, copy, audiences, offers and forms

- Retargeting campaigns

- Monitoring ad frequency and creative fatigue

- Managing and recommending advertising budgets

- Tracking campaign performance

- Identifying poor-performing campaigns quickly

- Scaling campaigns that are generating quality leads

- Continually improving our cost per qualified lead



You should be comfortable creating advertising yourself using tools such as Canva, CapCut or similar platforms.



For more advanced creative or website work, you will have support from our existing team.



## WE CARE ABOUT RESULTS



We're not looking for someone who measures success based on how many ads they created.



We care about results.



You should understand and regularly report on metrics including:



**Cost Per Lead (CPL)**  

**Cost Per Qualified Lead**  

**Click-Through Rate (CTR)**  

**Cost Per Click (CPC)**  

**CPM**  

**Lead Form Conversion Rate**  

**Ad Frequency**  

**Lead Quality**  

**Campaign Spend**



Most importantly, we want someone who can look at these numbers and tell us:



**What's working? What's not? Why? And what are we changing next?**



## LEAD QUALIFICATION



Our Meta lead forms should help identify whether someone is actually a potential Casa Rentals client.



For example:



**Do you currently own a short-term rental?**



**Where is your property located?**



**Are you currently self-managing or using a property management company?**



**How many properties do you own?**



**When are you looking to start or change property management?**



Once a lead submits their information, our sales team takes over.



You are **NOT responsible for cold calling, sales, closing management agreements or onboarding properties.**



Your responsibility is building the machine that consistently delivers qualified opportunities to that team.



## EXPERIENCE WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We strongly prefer candidates with experience in:



- Meta Ads Manager

-
 and Instagram lead-generation campaigns

- Meta Instant Forms

- Audience creation and targeting

- Retargeting

- A/B testing

- Campaign optimization

- Canva

- Basic video advertising

- Marketing copywriting

- Tracking and reporting advertising KPIs



Experience marketing **real estate, vacation rentals, property management, home services or other high-value local services** is a major plus.



Google Ads experience is also valuable, although Meta will be our primary advertising platform initially.



## THE PERSON WE WANT



We're looking for someone who is analytical AND creative.



You shouldn't need us to tell you every ad to create.



We want someone who can come to us and say:



*"This audience is outperforming the others, this creative is getting tired, CPL increased this week, and here's what I think we should test next."*



We move fast, test ideas and make decisions based on results.



If something isn't working, we change it.



If something is working, we figure out how to scale it.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please don't send us a generic VA application.



Start your application with the words:



**CASA TEXAS**



Then answer the following:



1. How many years have you personally managed Meta Ads?



2. What types of businesses have you generated leads for?



3. What is the largest monthly Meta advertising budget you have personally managed?



4. Give us an example of a campaign you managed. What was the goal, monthly spend, CPL and result?



5. What metrics do you look at when d
 whether to keep, modify or stop an ad?



6. Explain how you would target Airbnb/VRBO property owners in San Antonio.



7. If our ads were generating cheap leads but our sales team told you the leads were terrible, what would you change?



8. What would you test first if a campaign's CPL suddenly doubled?



9. Can you create your own graphics and basic video ads? What programs do you use?



10. Please provide examples/screenshots of campaigns you have personally managed. You may remove or blur confidential client information.



11. Please provide 2–3 examples of advertising creative you personally created.



12. What is your expected hourly or monthly salary?



### FINAL APPLICATION QUESTION



Imagine Casa Rentals gives you a **$1,500 Meta advertising budget for the next 30 days**.



Our goal is to find vacation rental owners in San Antonio who are either tired of self-managing their Airbnb/VRBO or unhappy with their current management company.



In a few paragraphs, explain:



**How would you spend the $1,500?**



Tell us what campaigns you would create, who you would target, what types of ads you would run, what you would test and how you would determine whether the campaign was successful.



We care more about how you think than having a perfect answer.

description:

We're looking for someone with strong Photoshop skills, a genuine eye for design, and the kind of attention to detail that catches a mistake before it goes out the door. The right person is comfortable working independently from a template, keeps a steady pace through a busy season, and takes pride in getting the small details exactly right.



About Good Luck Grams

Good Luck Grams creates custom keepsake posters for gymnastics meets across the country. Our “Grams” are displayed throughout the venue before competition begins, giving families a meaningful way to encourage their gymnast. After the meet, each family takes their Gram home as a lasting keepsake.



We work with gyms and meet directors nationwide, managing everything from design through production, shipping, and meet day display. Our busy season runs November through April, with order volume growing every year.



Key Responsibilities

Design & Production

- Populate each meet's approved template with individual order details: gymnast name, level, gym, and personal message.

- Drop in and mask out the background of each submitted photo, using Photoshop's AI selection tools for fast, accurate masking.

- Use Photoshop's Generative AI tools to fix photo issues, such as recreating a cropped-out elbow, instead of requesting a new photo (unless the resolution is too low).

- Make text corrections directly to existing JPG files without recreating the entire Gram.

- Adjust text sizing and layout so names and messages of different lengths still look clean and balanced.



Quality & Accuracy

- Proofread every file for spelling, correct gym, and correct details before marking it complete.

- Keep each order's data matched to the correct spreadsheet row so details and photos never get mixed up between Grams.

- Flag anything unclear using the designated notes field rather than letting it slide.



Workflow & Communication

- Check the order spreadsheet regularly and work through new orders as they arrive.

- Work within a shared Google Drive, organized by meet, using the designated business
.

- Communicate status and questions clearly so nothing gets lost.



Qualifications

Experience

- Previous experience with high volume, template based design work.

- Proficiency in Photoshop required, including familiarity with its newer Generative AI tools.

- Must have the latest version of Photoshop on your own computer. The software is not provided.



Skills

- A genuine eye for design: knowing when text or layout doesn't look right, and how to fix it.

- Comfortable working independently from a template and a spreadsheet of order data.

- Reliable internet and a personal computer capable of running Photoshop smoothly.



Personal Attributes

- Strong, consistent attention to detail. This is the single most important skill for this role.

- Methodical when working row by row through a spreadsheet, so the right photo and details always land on the right Gram.

- Takes initiative and doesn't need to be micromanaged.

- Able to overlap with North American working hours when needed for check-ins or urgent requests.



How to Apply

We're accepting applications through October 12th, 2026. We're looking to have someone started and onboarded by October 31, 2026.



Fill out the application form here --> 



Please don't DM or
 us directly. We're only accepting applicants through the form.

title: Senior Credit Analyst - Banking Background
description:
About Buildfund



Buildfund is a growing funding business that provides finance solutions to businesses and is entering an exciting period of expansion.



With a significant new funding line secured and additional capital being injected into the business, Buildfund is rapidly building its team to support a major growth push towards the end of the year.



We are looking for an experienced Senior Credit Analyst with a strong banking background to play a key role in assessing credit applications, managing risk, and supporting sound lending decisions.



Senior Credit Analyst 

As a Senior Credit Analyst, you will assess the creditworthiness of prospective borrowers and make informed recommendations based on financial information, business performance, credit history, and overall risk profile.

 

Key Responsibilities

* Assess and analyse credit applications and supporting financial information.

* Review financial statements, bank statements, cash flow, and other relevant documentation.

* Assess borrower financial performance, repayment capacity, and overall risk.

* Identify credit risks, inconsistencies, and potential red flags.

* Prepare clear and well-supported credit recommendations.

* Conduct due diligence and verify information provided by applicants.

* Maintain accurate credit assessment records and documentation.



What We're Looking For

* 3–5 years of experience in credit analysis, credit assessment, or lending.

* Strong banking background, preferably in commercial lending, SME lending, business banking, or credit risk.

* Strong understanding of credit assessment and lending risk.

* Ability to analyze financial statements and assess business financial health.

* Strong understanding of cash flow, debt servicing capacity, profitability, and liquidity.

* Strong communication skills, analytical skills and attention to detail.

* Ability to work independently and make sound credit recommendations.



Highly Desirable

* Experience assessing SME or commercial lending applications.

* Experience with business loans, working capital facilities, asset finance, or similar lending products.

* Experience helping develop or improve credit policies and processes.

* Exposure to credit decisioning systems or lending platforms.



What Buildfund Offers

* PHP 50,000–55,000 monthly salary, depending on experience and capability.

* Salary increase after 6 months probation

* HMO coverage after 30 days.

* 5:45 AM – 2:45 PM PH shift.

* Fully remote work.

* Ongoing learning and professional development.

title: P&C Insurance Virtual Assistant
description:
Location: Remote

Pay: $6 per hour

Schedule: Must be available during agreed-upon Pacific Time business hours.



We’re looking for an experienced, organized, and proactive Property & Casualty Insurance Virtual Assistant to support our insurance agency with quoting, binding support, policy servicing, renewals, and client communication.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with U.S. insurance carriers and carrier portals, understands insurance workflows, and is comfortable speaking with clients over the phone. Answering calls and following up with leads are essential parts of this position.



Responsibilities

Quoting and Carrier Coordination

- Collect client information and documents needed to prepare insurance quotes.

- Enter applications into carrier portals and request quotes from carriers and wholesalers.

- Review carrier appetite and underwriting guidelines to help identify suitable submission options.

- Prepare quote comparisons and proposals for the agent’s review.

- Communicate with underwriters and follow up on outstanding requirements.

Binding and Policy Servicing

- Coordinate binding requests, signatures, payments, and required documents under the licensed agent’s direction.

- Follow up on policy issuance and delivery.

- Assist with endorsements, certificates of insurance, ID cards, and policy changes.

- Handle routine billing inquiries and coordinate service requests with carriers.

- Perform activities within applicable licensing requirements and agency and carrier authorization.

Phone Support and Lead Follow-Ups

- Answer incoming calls professionally and assist new and existing clients.

- Make outbound calls to follow up with leads, pending quotes, and incomplete applications.

- Build rapport with clients, collect information, and explain the next steps clearly.

- Follow up by phone,
, and text using agency-approved communication.

- Schedule calls with the licensed agent for coverage advice or more complex questions.

- Record conversations and maintain clear follow-up tasks.

Renewals and Administrative Support

- Track upcoming renewals and request updated client information.

- Follow up with clients and carriers to keep renewals moving.

- Flag cancellation notices, missing requirements, and urgent issues promptly.

- Keep the CRM, client records, policy documents, and pipelines accurate.

- Provide daily updates on completed work, pending requests, and items requiring attention.



Requirements

- Previous experience supporting a U.S. P&C insurance agency.

- Experience with personal lines, commercial lines, or both.

- Working knowledge of carrier portals and insurance processes, including quoting, binding support, servicing, and renewals.

- Strong spoken and written English and confidence communicating with clients by phone.

- Comfortable answering inbound calls and making outbound follow-up calls.

- Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management.

- Ability to manage multiple requests and follow through without repeated reminders.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, headset, and quiet workspace.

- Ability to handle confidential client information responsibly.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with California insurance accounts.

- Familiarity with auto, home, general liability, workers’ compensation, commercial auto, or contractor bonds.

- Experience with BTIS, First Connect, comparative raters, or other carrier and wholesaler platforms.

- Familiarity with GoHighLevel, agency management systems, Microsoft Outlook, and Google Workspace.



How to Apply

Please send:

1. Your resume highlighting your insurance experience.

2. A one-minute audio recording introducing yourself and sharing your relevant experience. Include the insurance products you’ve worked with, your experience with carriers, and your comfort handling client calls.

3. A list of the carrier portals and insurance platforms you have used.



We’re looking for someone dependable who communicates clearly, takes ownership of follow-ups, and helps deliver responsive, professional service to our clients.

, and text

title: Executive & Personal Assistant / Personal Operations Manager
description:
Executive & Personal Assistant / Personal Operations Manager



PLEASE CHECK FIT BEFORE APPLYING



This is an experienced, hands-on executive support role, not an entry-level VA training position. Apply only if all of these describe you:

• You have personally supported an owner, executive or manager with calendar/scheduling, inbox or business correspondence, and follow-up on commitments through completion. Equivalent operations experience counts; a particular job title or degree is not required.

• You can give one specific past example of a commitment you personally brought to completion, including your action and the result. General claims about being organized or proactive are not enough.

• You want an ongoing role starting at 15–20 TOTAL hours per week at $6–$10 USD/hour. We are not offering full-time hours at the start.

• You can commit to at least two predictable hours EVERY Monday–Friday within 8 AM–4 PM California/Pacific Time, adjusting for California daylight-saving changes. Other work must not conflict with that coverage.

• You have handled professional phone calls in English and are ready to make scheduling, vendor and follow-up calls. This is not a non-voice role; previous U.S. calling experience is helpful but not mandatory.



If your experience is limited to coursework, VA training, data entry, lead generation or chat support, without the ownership described above, this role is unlikely to be the right fit.



I am an orthodontist, small-business owner, husband, and father in California looking for one exceptional long-term assistant in the Philippines.

This is not a basic task-taking VA role.

I need someone who can help create order around a busy professional and family life: capture open loops, organize priorities, follow up, research, communicate, coordinate with employees and vendors, manage calendars and
 workflows, and make sure important commitments do not disappear.

The right person will be proactive, organized, comfortable with ambiguity, and willing to respectfully challenge me when I am avoiding something important or getting distracted by lower-priority work.



Your first month



Start with three outcomes:

• turn incoming requests into clear next actions and follow-up

• maintain the calendar and protect time for work only the owner can do

• bring a small agreed set of business and family commitments through to completion

The first month is a paid mutual-fit period with weekly feedback. We will introduce responsibilities and access progressively; you are not expected to fix every practice or household process at once.



How the role can grow



Over time, help with research, vendor and appointment coordination, inbox cleanup,
 triage, replies within agreed authority, recurring reminders, project follow-up and lightweight documentation. Coordinate with our existing team and remote assistant. You do not replace clinical judgment or automatically manage office staff.

You will not be expected to know orthodontics when you start.



What I am looking for



You should be:

• extremely organized

• reliable with strong follow-through

• proactive rather than waiting for detailed instructions

• comfortable making recommendations

• confident enough to respectfully challenge your employer

• excellent in written and spoken English

• comfortable making phone calls to U.S. businesses

• highly capable with technology

• experienced using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude

• discreet with confidential information

• thoughtful about security and privacy

• able to distinguish urgent from important

• comfortable working with imperfect information

• interested in a long-term role

I am specifically not looking for someone who asks me what to do at every step. I want someone who can say:

"Here is the problem, here is what I found, here is what I recommend, and here is what I need from you."



Schedule



Approximately 15–20 hours per week initially.

Our initial coverage target is at least two predictable hours each weekday within 8 AM–4 PM California/Pacific Time for calls, coordination and the short daily check-in. Please propose a sustainable window; we will agree exact hours before an offer. California daylight-saving changes must be reflected in the agreed schedule.

Remaining work may be asynchronous. This is not an all-day on-call role; urgent matters outside your agreed hours remain with the owners or designated onsite staff.



Compensation



$6–$10 USD/hour depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



AI



AI use is encouraged. I use AI extensively and want an assistant who knows how to use it well.

AI should improve your judgment and efficiency—not replace your judgment.



How to Apply



Start your answer to question 1 with this compact fit summary (fill in your actual details):

15–20 total hours/week: yes | Mon–Fri Pacific window: __ to __ | Requested rate: $__/hour | Relevant owner/operations support: __

Then complete question 1 and answer questions 2–7. A resume or general cover letter alone does not complete the application. Incomplete applications or generic claims without a specific ownership example may not advance.

Keep your answers concise. You may use AI, but if you do, tell me briefly how you used it.

Finalists will be invited to complete a paid practical exercise based on realistic work from this role.



Application Questionnaire



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with numbered answers. No separate application form is required. Keep the entire response concise, approximately 400 words or fewer. AI assistance is welcome if disclosed.



1. Availability and rate



Confirm that 15–20 hours/week initially works for you. Give your exact Monday–Friday start and end times in Pacific Time, including at least two hours entirely within 8 AM–4 PM, and your requested hourly rate within the advertised range. Note any overlapping work commitments without naming clients. If your availability differs, say so plainly.



2. Relevant experience



Describe your most similar owner/executive support role and what you personally owned.



3. Ownership and pushback



Describe one actual i
 in 3–5 sentences: what commitment was at risk, what YOU personally did, and what happened. Use Situation / My action / Result. A small, specific example is better than general statements about being proactive. Anonymize private details; no work samples are needed.



4. Security judgment



An unexpected bank-reset
 arrives in an inbox you help with. In two or three sentences, what do you do?



5. AI use



Give one useful AI example and how you checked the result. Disclose any AI used for this application.



6. Calls



Calls for scheduling, vendor coordination and follow-up are part of this role. Briefly describe one professional call you personally handled, its purpose and outcome, and whether you have called U.S. businesses. If your experience is written support only, say so; willingness to learn and prior experience are different.



7. Reliability and individual work



Describe your internet/power backup plan. Will you personally perform the work? Any proposed helper, agency involvement or subcontracting must be disclosed; account sharing or undisclosed substitutes are not permitted.

Do not submit identification documents, bank details, passwords, or a previous employer's confidential work.

title: Loan Processing & Collections Team Lead – Canadian Lender (Night Shift)
description:
LOAN PROCESSING & COLLECTIONS TEAM LEAD – CANADIAN LENDER

₱68,000 – ₱133,000 per month | Full-time | Long-term | Work from home



WHO WE ARE

 if a loan should be approved or declined, following our lending rules

, Slack, CRM and loan software)

- Organized, fast and detail-oriented

- Comfortable with computers and quick to learn new software

- Good in written and spoken English



BIG ADVANTAGES

- You have approved or declined loans yourself

- You have handled collections or past-due accounts

WHAT WE OFFER

- ₱68,000 to ₱133,000 per month (CAD $9 to $14 per hour), depending on your experience and the number of hours

- Paid in Canadian dollars by a Canadian company

title: Client Travel Coordinator & Booking Specialist (Cruise & Luxury Travel)
description:
About the Company

How We’ll Work Together

Initial Client Discovery by Zoom

Host an onboarding and intake video call with the client using our intake checklist.

Unpack their travel preferences: flight cabin class, preferred airlines, seat choices, layover tolerances, and hotel stays before or after the cruise.

Review AI meeting transcripts and ensure the output is accurate, clean, and translated into actionable operational notes.



Vendor Coordination and Research

Contact cruise lines directly, such as Viking and AmaWaterways, by phone and through travel advisor portals to secure holds, clarify stateroom availability, and gather quotes.

Research flight itineraries using provided flight research and booking tools, matching the cruise embarkation and disembarkation schedule.

Source travel insurance, transfers and any other quotes needed for trip

Coordinate with the agency on preferred vendors and agency approved booking tools.



Trip Summary and Briefing

Use provided software & AI to package research, quotes, and options into a polished trip summary for the client.

Deliver an organized briefing to the agency ahead of the call with the client.

This work typically takes place after the cruise or primary trip is booked and focuses on the remaining travel logistics.



Final Booking Execution

Once the client’s selections are finalized, handle the execution: book the cruise, arrange flights through our preferred booking companies, confirm hotels, issue insurance, and verify every confirmation number, date, and passenger detail.

Note: Our flight booking partners handle the actual airline reservations and ticketing.



Core Responsibilities

Provide seamless management of video, phone, and
 communication with clients who expect highly attentive, personal service.

Manage communications with cruise line reservation desks, including Viking, AmaWaterways, and other ocean and river cruise lines.

Arrange flights through our preferred booking companies, ensuring routes and arrival times align with the trip.

Research, compare, and present hotel stays before and after the cruise and travel protection policies.

Build, maintain, and update client records and itineraries inside our travel software.

Double check booking details, including legal names, passport expiration dates, transfer vouchers, and dining reservations.



Qualifications and Requirements

Cruise Booking Experience: Demonstrated background booking ocean and river cruises is crucial. Direct experience with Viking is a major advantage.

Independent Travel Advisor Background: Prior experience working for an independent travel agency, host agency, or boutique travel advisor is highly preferred.

Software: Hands on experience with Tern travel CRM and itinerary management software is highly desirable.

Demeanor: Confident, warm, and professional verbal communication over video and phone. Experience working with discerning US travelers who have high expectations.

Relentless Attention to Detail: Zero tolerance for booking errors, miscalculated dates, or misspelled names on flight or cruise manifests. To demonstrate your attention to detail, please include the word STARBOARD in your
 response.

Schedule: Dedicated availability during US daytime business hours to coordinate live with clients and suppliers.



How to Apply

Please apply with the following:

Subject Line: Client Travel Coordinator | [Your Full Name] | [Your Favorite Cruise Line]

title: lead researcher
description:
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 hours per day (40 hours/week)

Position: Full-Time Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED.



Do NOT apply if you have never sourced profitable products for Amazon FBA before. I am specifically looking for someone who already understands Amazon product sourcing and can work independently.



You should already know how to analyze Amazon listings, research suppliers, verify websites, check sellers and competition, calculate profit, and determine whether a product is actually worth purchasing.



YOUR MAIN JOB



You must provide 5 VALID ASINs per day.



That equals 25 valid ASINs per week.



Finding 5 random products does NOT count. Products must meet ALL of my requirements and pass my review.



If some of your daily ASINs are rejected, you have until the end of the week/payday to replace them and reach the required 25 valid ASINs.



25 approved ASINs per week is the minimum requirement — not just 25 submissions.



BONUSES 💰



I reward VAs who consistently provide good leads and help me grow the business.



You can earn additional bonuses for:



Consistently finding valid ASINs: If your leads regularly pass my review and meet all requirements, you can receive performance bonuses.



More than 25 approved ASINs: If you finish your required 25 valid ASINs early and continue finding additional approved products, you can receive a bonus for exceeding your weekly target.



Finding profitable Amazon seller storefronts: If you discover a strong Online Arbitrage seller storefront that I can use for further product research, submit the storefront to me. If I review it and approve it as a good sourcing opportunity, you can receive a bonus.



High-quality sourcing: VAs who consistently find products that I actually purchase and successfully sell will have opportunities for additional bonuses and higher pay over time.



Quality still matters. Adding random ASINs just to go above 25 will NOT earn a bonus. Extra ASINs must meet the same requirements as your normal submissions and pass my review.



PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS



Every product you submit must:



Be a brand I am already approved/ungated to sell



Make at least $2 profit per unit



Have at least 50 estimated sales per month



NOT be a generic brand



Have realistic competition where I can actually get sales



Have enough room for me to enter the listing without immediately destroying the price



Come from a REAL, TRUSTWORTHY SOURCE



Be in stock and actually available to purchase



Match the EXACT Amazon product/variation



Include the correct source link



Include the correct Amazon ASIN/listing



Not already have been submitted by another VA on my team



ROI is NOT my main requirement. I care more about actual dollar profit, sales volume, competition, and whether I can realistically sell the inventory.



QUANTITY MATTERS



Do NOT submit deals that only become profitable when purchasing an unrealistic quantity.



Example:



If a product only meets my requirements when buying 25 units, but the Amazon listing only sells around 50 units per month and has 20 competing sellers, I am obviously not going to purchase 25 units.



Use common sense.



Look at:



Monthly sales + number of sellers + competition + minimum purchase quantity.



The deal needs to make sense for MY business, not just look profitable on a spreadsheet.



SOURCE VERIFICATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You MUST verify every website before submitting it.



I recently had a VA provide a fake website that looked like a major retailer. A purchase was made from the website and the card information was compromised.



That cannot happen again.



Before submitting ANY unfamiliar website, verify that it is legitimate.



Do NOT submit:



Fake retailer websites



Scam websites

Real, growing volume for those who deliver

title: Long Term Digital Marketing Specialist (Dayshift)
description:

ABOUT THE BUSINESS:

Our goal is simple: Get the right content in front of the right audience and turn attention into qualified leads and sales.**



We work with a specialist team of media buyers, graphic designers, video editors, content writers, developers, and marketing professionals to deliver high-performing campaigns for our clients.



ABOUT THE ROLE:



We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Coordinator to take ownership of coordinating client marketing campaigns from planning through to launch.



You will work closely with clients and our internal delivery team to ensure campaigns are strategically aligned, delivered on time, high quality, and ready to perform.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



Campaign Management



* Plan and coordinate multiple marketing and lead generation campaigns from concept through to launch.

* Manage timelines, deliverables, deadlines, and dependencies.

* Coordinate clients, media buyers, designers, video editors, content writers, developers, and other specialists.

* Ensure everyone understands what needs to be delivered and when.



Campaign Strategy & Quality Control



* Identify the #1 pain point the campaign is solving and ensure it is relevant to the target audience.

* Ensure consistent messaging across the entire customer journey, including **ads, creative, landing pages, lead magnets, funnels,
s, and calls to action**.

* Review campaign assets and identify gaps, errors, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.

* Ensure campaigns are as strong as possible before going live.



Content & Optimisation



* Review, rewrite, and optimise ad copy, landing page copy, funnel copy,
 copy, headlines, and calls to action** when required.

* Ensure messaging is clear, compelling, consistent, and aligned with the campaign objective.



Problem Solving & Launch



* Identify roadblocks, missing information, risks, and issues early.

* Proactively solve problems and escalate issues when necessary.

* Conduct final campaign checks before launch.

* Organise and document all campaign assets and information.

* Provide a clear handover to the Media Buyer for post-launch management and optimisation.



SOFTWARE & TOOLS



You will use:

*Loom— Screen recordings

*Slack— Team communication

*ClickUp— Project management
