*Google Sheets — Tracking & reporting



Experience with these tools is an advantage, but we can provide training.



REQUIREMENTS



This role is ideal for someone who:



* Has 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, campaign coordination, project management, lead generation, or a similar role.

* Understands paid digital advertising and lead generation.

* Is highly organised and comfortable managing multiple campaigns and deadlines.

* Can confidently communicate with clients and internal team members.

* Has strong problem-solving, decision-making, and leadership abilities.

* Is proactive and takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.

* Has excellent attention to detail and a results-driven mindset.

* Enjoys working with creative, marketing, and technical specialists.

* Is eager to learn, improve, and take on greater responsibility.



The Type of person we're looking for:



We are looking for someone who:



*Thinks ahead.

*Takes ownership.

*Spots problems early.

*Solves problems proactively.

*Communicates clearly.

*Pays attention to detail.

*Works well with others.

*Wants to learn and improve.



You don't need to know everything on Day 1. We will train you on our systems and processes.

What we do need is someone with the attitude, initiative, and work ethic to become exceptional at the role.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



You will be successful when:



* Campaigns launch on time with minimal delays or last-minute issues.

* Projects are organised and everyone knows what they are responsible for.

* Campaigns are high quality with strong and consistent messaging across every touchpoint.

* Problems are identified early and resolved proactively rather than becoming larger issues.

* Clients are well communicated with and feel confident that their campaigns are being managed professionally.

* Team members have what they need to complete their work efficiently.

* Campaign handovers are complete and organised allowing Media Buyers to take over smoothly.

* You consistently identify opportunities to improve campaigns, messaging, and processes**.

* You require progressively less supervision because you understand what needs to be done and take initiative.

* Ultimately, the campaigns you coordinate contribute to quality leads, sales, and measurable growth for our clients.**



The ultimate measure of success:



*Clients are happy.

*Campaigns launch on time.

*The work is high quality.

*Problems are solved before they become problems.

*Our campaigns generate results.**

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:

title: Senior FP&A Analyst – Strategic Finance & Financial Modeling
description:
Senior FP&A Analyst – Strategic Finance & Financial Modeling

Location: Remote – Philippines

Job Type: Full-Time

Schedule: U.S. Pacific Time / Philippine Graveyard Shift

Compensation: $10–$12 USD per hour, depending on experience, qualifications, and financial modeling capabilities



About the Role

A growing U.S.-based company is looking for a highly analytical Senior FP&A Analyst with strong financial modeling experience to support management with forecasting, pricing, profitability analysis, scenario modeling, and strategic financial planning.



This is not a bookkeeping, general accounting, or basic financial reporting position.



We are looking for someone who can take financial and operational data, build models from scratch, identify what is driving the results, and help management determine what actions should be taken next.



The right person should be comfortable answering questions such as:

- What happens to gross margin if selling price, product cost, freight, tariffs, or volume changes?

- What selling price is required to achieve a target gross margin?

- Which products or customers are generating the strongest and weakest profitability?

- What is driving the difference between actual results, forecast, and budget?

- What combination of revenue growth, pricing, margin improvement, product mix, and cost reductions is required to achieve an EBITDA target?

- Where are the biggest financial opportunities or risks management should be focused on?



Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain integrated financial models for revenue, gross profit, gross margin, operating expenses, and EBITDA.

- Develop annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and longer-term financial projections.

- Build pricing and profitability models using selling price, product cost, freight, duties/tariffs, landed cost, volume, and other business drivers.

- Perform scenario and sensitivity analysis for changes in pricing, volume, product mix, freight, sourcing, costs, and other assumptions.

- Develop models comparing different shipping and sourcing scenarios and their impact on landed cost and profitability.

- Determine required selling prices to achieve target gross margins.

- Analyze actual results versus budget and forecast and clearly explain the drivers behind variances.

- Develop EBITDA bridge and gap-to-target analysis.

- Analyze profitability by product, customer, and business line.

- Analyze historical customer purchasing behavior to identify trends, declining customers, cross-selling opportunities, and potential areas for revenue growth.

- Support working-capital analysis, including accounts receivable, inventory, and accounts payable.

- Build management dashboards and financial reporting that highlight trends, risks, and opportunities.

- Work with large datasets from accounting, ERP, sales, and operational systems.

- Perform ad hoc financial analysis for management.

- Present findings clearly and provide actionable recommendations rather than simply reporting numbers.

- Help improve and automate existing financial models and reporting processes.



What We Are Looking For

- Minimum 5 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, strategic finance, financial modeling, or a closely related role.

- Strong experience building financial models from scratch.

- Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills.

- Strong understanding of P&L, revenue, COGS, gross margin, EBITDA, operating expenses, cash flow, and working capital.

- Hands-on experience with budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and scenario modeling.

- Experience with pricing, profitability, margin, or unit-economics analysis.

- Ability to work with large datasets and turn them into useful financial insights.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- High attention to detail and accuracy.

- Ability to identify issues and opportunities proactively rather than waiting for management to request an analysis.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Comfortable working directly with finance leadership and management.

- Must be comfortable working full-time U.S. Pacific Time hours / Philippine graveyard shift.



Preferred Qualifications

- CPA, CMA, CFA, MBA, or similar finance/accounting qualification.

- Experience with Power BI, Power Query, SQL, or similar analytics tools.

- Experience with QuickBooks Online or ERP systems.

- Experience in manufacturing, distribution, wholesale, inventory-based businesses, or e-commerce.

- Experience with landed-cost modeling, freight/logistics, duties, or tariffs.

- Experience with customer and product profitability analysis.

- Experience using AI or automation tools to improve financial analysis and reporting.



What Success Looks Like

We are not looking for someone who simply prepares reports.

We want someone who can look at the numbers and tell management:

What happened? Why did it happen? What is likely to happen next? What should we do about it?

You should be comfortable challenging assumptions, identifying unusual trends, and bringing issues or opportunities to management before being asked.



How to Apply

Please include the following with your application:

1. Your resume.

2. Your expected hourly rate in USD.

3. Confirmation that you are comfortable working full-time U.S. Pacific Time / Philippine graveyard shift.

4. A sample financial model that you personally built. You may remove or hide any confidential company or client information.

5. A brief explanation of what the model was designed to accomplish and which portions you personally built.



Applications without a financial modeling sample may not be considered.

Shortlisted candidates should be prepared to discuss their model and explain the assumptions, formulas, drivers, scenarios, and conclusions during the interview.

title: Bilingual Appointment Setter (French C1/C2 + English)
description:

Vision Bleu LED installs permanent smart architectural lighting on homes in the Montréal area, Québec, Canada. We are not asking you to sell. We are asking you to fill the calendar.



You never start from zero. Marketing puts people who already asked about us into our CRM every day. Your job is to call them, qualify them and book their appointment with one of our advisors.



THE ROLE

- Call every new lead, in the lead's own language (mostly Québec French, some English), following our script

- Qualify on need, region and timeline, using price ranges to set expectations (never a quote)

- Book the consultation directly in an advisor's calendar

- Log every call in the CRM the same day

- Send a short end-of-day recap



You do not sell or quote. 



PAY AND STATUS

- CAD $8 to $10 per hour, set at hire, paid whatever the day's results

- Plus CAD $5 per confirmed appointment (a real slot booked in an advisor's calendar)

- No cap on the appointment bonus. No commission of any kind

- Training after signature is paid at your hourly rate.



WHAT YOU NEED

- French: master level (C1/C2), spoken and written, comfortable with Québec French (accent and expressions). English: fluent, spoken and written. This is required because our leads are in Montréal and arrive in both languages (nécessaire à l'accomplissement de la tâche)

- A quiet room, your own computer, a headset and a stable internet connection (at least 20 Mbps down, 5 Mbps up)

- Availability on a fixed schedule, Eastern time: Monday to Thursday 9:00–12:00 and 15:00–20:00, Friday 9:00–17:00 (about 40 hours a week). Please check what this is in your local time

- Comfort calling people who do not know you, for hours, every day, and taking a "no" without taking it personally



No sales experience required. We train you.



HOW TO APPLY (all 3 are required, otherwise your application is not reviewed)

1. In French, two sentences: « Pourquoi es-tu à l'aise d'appeler des inconnus au téléphone, toute la journée? »

2. A SCREEN RECORDING (30–60 seconds) of an internet speed test (speedtest.net or 
): the whole screen visible, with the date and time and the download, upload and ping results shown.

3. An AUDIO RECORDING (one file, quiet room, normal pace) in which you:

   a) Say your full name and today's date

FRENCH SCRIPT

« Bonjour, je m'appelle [ton prénom], je suis l'adjoint(e) au consultant chez Vision Bleu LED à Montréal. J'ai vu que tu as rempli un formulaire pour un projet d'éclairage intelligent pour ta maison, c'est bien ça? Je voulais juste te poser deux ou trois petites questions, puis te réserver une rencontre avec l'un de nos conseillers, mardi à quatorze heures trente ou jeudi à dix-neuf heures, selon ce qui te convient le mieux. »



ENGLISH SCRIPT

"Hi, my name is [your first name], I'm an assistant to the advisor at Vision Bleu LED in Montréal. I saw that you filled out a form about a smart lighting project for your home, is that right? I just have two or three quick questions, and then I'd like to book you a short meeting with one of our advisors, either Tuesday at 2:30 p.m. or Thursday at 7 p.m., whichever works best for you."



Send all 3 as links (Google Drive, Loom or Vocaroo) in your application message. Vision Bleu LED



Looking forward to chatting with you!

Requirements

    •  Strong Xero experience.

    •  Experience with bank and account reconciliations.

title: Video (UGC) editor
description:
Video Editor (Remote, Full-Time)

We're a performance creative agency. We help e-commerce brands doing €100K–€2M/month scale their Meta ads with creative that actually wins. We don't sell "content." We sell winning ads.



Right now our concepts are outpacing our hands. Our creative strategist builds the scripts, hooks and angles off real performance data, and our creators shoot the content. What we need is someone who can take those briefings and that footage and turn them into scroll-stopping, converting video ads.



It's for someone who owns the craft of editing and gets sharper every single week.



What you'll do

- Turn briefings from our creative strategist and raw creator footage into finished direct-response video ads for Meta

- Edit high-converting UGC and short-form ads: hooks, pacing, captions and sound design

- Match every cut to the exact line it sits under. Most editors grab b-roll that's vaguely on-topic and the ad dies. You won't.

- Iterate fast off performance data. What won, what died, and why, every week.

- Build your own hooks and iterations, not just execute someone else's timeline.

- Spot what's working and scale it. When a concept wins, we make more of it.



Why this seat is different

- You see the data. You get access to all our performance numbers, so you always know what's working and why.

- Weekly call with your lead. We go through your ads together, you get direct feedback, and you level up off it. No guessing.

- We pay for your tools. Every tool and subscription you need is on us. Find a new one that makes you faster or better? Tell us and we'll get it.



Full-time, long-term. We want someone in the business with us.



Where this can lead

Editor → Editor Lead → (if it's really in you) Creative Strategist.



Every step is a pay rise, based on performance. If you start thinking about why an ad works, not just how to cut it, you'll move fast.



You'll thrive here if

- You edit high-converting UGC and short-form video ads

- You think in hooks, pacing and retention, not filters and transitions

- You know Premiere Pro cold (this is a MUST)

- You take blunt feedback and come back with a better cut the same day

- You work independently and hit your deadlines without being chased

- You're hungry. You screenshot ads you scroll past and have real opinions on why a hook works

- Your written and spoken English is strong (highest-level non-native is fine)



Don't apply if

- You edit for looks, not conversions

- You're a freelancer looking to stack another client. This is full-time.

None of those people last here.



The offer

- Up to €1,500/month

- Paid per batch

- Your tools and subscriptions paid

- Full-time, remote, direct line to your lead and the data

title: Senior FP&A / Financial Modeling Analyst
description:
Senior FP&A / Financial Modeling Analyst

Remote – Philippines | Full-Time

About the Role

A growing U.S.-based company is looking for a highly analytical Senior FP&A / Financial Modeling Analyst to support its Finance team.

This role will work closely with senior Finance leadership and will focus heavily on financial modeling, forecasting, profitability analysis, pricing, margins, and management decision support.

This is not a traditional accounting or bookkeeping position. We are looking for someone who can take financial and operational data, build reliable models, identify trends and opportunities, and turn the results into forward-looking analysis that helps management make better business decisions.

Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain detailed financial models for revenue, gross profit, gross margin, EBITDA, and overall profitability.

- Develop product-level pricing and margin models incorporating selling price, product cost, freight, duties/tariffs, and other landed costs.

- Analyze gross margins against company targets and identify products, customers, or transactions that are below target.

- Develop scenario and sensitivity models to evaluate the impact of changes in:

  - Selling prices

  - Product costs

  - Freight and shipping methods

  - Duties and tariffs

  - Sales volume

  - Product mix

  - Other operating assumptions

- Analyze different shipping and sourcing scenarios and determine their impact on landed cost, gross margin, and profitability.

- Identify pricing opportunities and determine the selling prices required to achieve targeted gross margins.

- Develop models showing the financial impact of pricing increases, purchasing savings, freight savings, and other cost-reduction opportunities.

- Build and maintain EBITDA forecasts and bridge analyses showing the impact of pricing, volume, product mix, gross margin, freight, purchasing savings, and operating expenses.

- Support annual budgeting, monthly forecasting, and longer-term financial planning.

- Perform actual vs. budget and actual vs. forecast analysis and explain the key drivers behind variances.

- Analyze historical financial and operational trends and develop forward-looking projections.

- Work with large datasets from accounting, ERP, sales, inventory, purchasing, and other business systems.

- Develop management dashboards and reports that clearly identify trends, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring management action.

- Perform product, customer, and business-line profitability analysis.

- Work closely with Finance and IT to improve the accuracy, efficiency, and automation of financial analysis and reporting.

- Perform ad hoc financial modeling and analysis requested by senior management.

- Present findings in a clear and concise manner and provide actionable financial insights rather than simply reporting numbers.

Required Qualifications

- Minimum 5 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, financial analysis, or financial modeling.

- Demonstrated experience building sophisticated financial models from the ground up.

- Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills.

- Strong understanding of revenue, COGS, gross profit, gross margin, EBITDA, operating expenses, and working capital.

- Strong experience with budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.

- Experience with pricing, profitability, margin, and scenario/sensitivity analysis.

- Ability to work with large and sometimes complex datasets.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to identify the business drivers behind financial results rather than simply reporting variances.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to independently validate financial information.

- Ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear recommendations for management.

- Comfortable working directly with senior Finance and company leadership.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

- Ability to work U.S. business hours as required.

Preferred Qualifications

- CPA, CMA, CFA, MBA, or similar professional qualification is a plus but not required.

- Experience with Power BI, Power Query, SQL, or similar business intelligence/data tools.

- Experience with QuickBooks Online, ERP systems, or similar accounting and operational systems.

- Experience working with manufacturing, distribution, wholesale, consumer products, inventory-intensive businesses, or landed-cost analysis.

- Experience analyzing freight, logistics, tariffs, duties, sourcing, or supply-chain costs.

- Experience using AI or other modern analytical tools to improve financial analysis, forecasting, scenario modeling, or reporting.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate should be able to take management questions such as:

“If we change our shipping method, what happens to landed cost and gross margin?”

“What selling price do we need to maintain our target gross margin?”

“Which products or customers are generating margins below our target, and why?”

“If product costs increase or decrease, what pricing changes are required to protect margin?”

“Where are our biggest opportunities to improve profitability?”

“What combination of pricing, margin improvement, sales growth, and cost reductions will allow us to achieve our annual EBITDA target?”

The expectation is not simply to provide numbers, but to build the model, analyze the results, identify the key drivers, and provide management with actionable insights.

Application Requirements

Please submit your resume along with a brief description of your FP&A and financial modeling experience.

In your application, please specifically describe:

- Financial models you have personally built.

- Your experience with pricing and gross-margin analysis.

- Your experience with forecasting and scenario/sensitivity modeling.

- Your experience building EBITDA or profitability forecasts.

- The most advanced Excel or Google Sheets model you have developed.

- Any experience with Power BI, Power Query, SQL, AI, or other analytical tools.

Examples of previous financial models or dashboards may be requested during the interview process. Please do not provide confidential information belonging to a current or former employer.

Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a practical financial modeling assessment.

title: Part-Time VA: Build a List of 150 Independent Personal Trainers in Sydney & Melbourne
description:
I'm an Australian founder doing customer research for a new project. No product yet, I'm talking to people first. I need someone to build a clean spreadsheet of 150 independent personal trainers across Sydney and Melbourne.



Independent means they run their own business and not employed by a gym chain. Look for people who have their own booking link, mention their ABN, describe themselves as a mobile or freelance PT, or clearly operate under their own brand. If someone only appears as staff on a gym's page with no independent presence, skip them.



Where to look: Google Maps (search "personal trainer" + suburb), Instagram (location tags, hashtags like #sydneypt #melbournept #mobilept), ClassPass and Mindbody listings, and public
 fitness groups. No scraping tools, no automation - I want manual verification so each entry is real.



What each row needs:



Full name

Business name (if any)

Suburb

Instagram handle

Public
 (if listed — leave blank if not, don't guess)

Source URL (the page you found them on)

Independence evidence (one line, e.g. "Own booking site linked in bio" or "Listed as sole trader on Google Maps")



Deliverable: One Google Sheet, 150 rows minimum, split roughly 75/75 between Sydney and Melbourne. I'll spot-check 20 random entries. If fewer than 17 of those 20 check out (correct info, genuinely independent), I'll ask you to redo the failed rows before final payment.



Hours: 10–15 hours over 5–7 days.



Pay: $75 fixed for the completed, verified list. Paid on delivery once the spot-check passes. If the work is good, there's a second project (different city, same format) and ongoing part-time hours.



To apply, reply with the word TRAINER in your first sentence so I know you read the full ad.

title: LinkedIn Appointment Setter & Sales Development Representative — Coaching and Consulting
description:
Big Business Advantage is seeking a confident, organized, persistent, and personable Appointment Setter and Sales Development Representative to help us connect with coaches, consultants, pastors, ministry leaders, experienced professionals, and selected business owners.



We provide structured business coaching and consulting solutions supported by business diagnostic tools, Profit Acceleration Software, Focused AI, human coaching, implementation support, and measurable-results tracking.



This is not a passive administrative position. We need someone who enjoys finding qualified prospects, starting genuine conversations, following up consistently, qualifying interest, and booking appointments.



The right candidate may eventually have the opportunity to develop into a sales closer or team leader.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



You will be responsible for:



• Finding qualified prospects on LinkedIn and other approved platforms  

• Researching each prospect before contacting them  

• Sending personalized LinkedIn connection requests  

• Starting professional, natural conversations with new connections  

• Following up consistently without becoming aggressive or spammy  

• Qualifying prospects according to our established criteria  

• Booking qualified appointments directly onto the company calendar  

• Confirming appointments and reducing no-shows  

• Updating every prospect’s status inside our CRM  

• Maintaining organized notes and accurate contact information  

• Re-engaging older prospects who did not initially respond  

• Following provided scripts while making each message sound personal  

• Reporting daily outreach, conversations, appointments, and results  

• Attending regular training, coaching, and accountability meetings  

• Learning our coaching, consulting, and business-growth services  

• Helping improve our scripts and outreach process based on actual responses  



TARGET PROSPECTS



You will primarily reach out to:



• Business coaches who need a stronger system for attracting and serving clients  

• Consultants who want structured diagnostics and measurable client solutions  

• Pastors and ministry leaders exploring ethical bivocational coaching or consulting  

• Experienced professionals considering a transition into coaching or consulting  

• Owner-operated service businesses that may benefit from business diagnostics, profit-opportunity analysis, implementation support, and accountability  



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO



• You will not make guaranteed income, profit, revenue, ROI, or client-acquisition claims.  

• You will not send mass spam or identical messages to hundreds of people.  

• You will not pressure pastors, church members, or business owners.  

• You will not misrepresent yourself as Pastor Peter Baptiste.  

• You will not claim that our software automatically generates clients or guarantees business results.  

• You will not publish content, change account settings, or make purchases without authorization.  

• You will not provide legal, accounting, investment, medical, or financial advice.  



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



The ideal candidate has:



• Proven experience in appointment setting, lead generation, sales development, or outbound sales  

• Strong written and spoken English  

• Confidence communicating with professionals, coaches, consultants, pastors, and business owners  

• Experience using LinkedIn for relationship-based prospecting  

• Excellent follow-up habits  

• The ability to communicate warmly without sounding scripted  

• Strong organizational and time-management skills  

• Careful attention to detail  

• Experience working with a CRM  

• The discipline to meet daily activity goals while protecting message quality  

• Reliable internet service and a dependable computer  

• The ability to work independently and accept coaching  

• High integrity and respect for confidential business information  



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



We would especially value:



• Experience booking appointments for coaching, consulting, SaaS, marketing, or professional services  

• Experience with GoHighLevel, LeadConnector, HubSpot, Salesforce, or a similar CRM  

• Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator  

• Experience speaking with pastors, ministry leaders, coaches, or business owners  

• Experience conducting qualification calls  

• Experience handling common sales objections  

• Previous success meeting appointment or sales targets  

• The ability to conduct short telephone or Zoom qualification conversations  

• Interest in eventually developing into a trained sales closer or team leader  



WORK SCHEDULE



• Starting as a part-time position  

• Approximately 20 hours per week  

• Monday through Friday  

• Schedule must overlap with prospecting hours in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, or New Zealand  

• Some flexibility will be available, but reliability during agreed working hours is essential  

• Additional hours may become available based on performance and business needs  



COMPENSATION



• Starting rate: USD $5.00–$7.00 per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability  

• Performance incentives may be available for qualified appointments that attend and for verified sales results  

• Compensation and incentives will be discussed clearly before hiring  

• Opportunity for increased hours, increased compensation, and advancement based on performance  



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Your performance will be evaluated using:



• Number of appropriately researched prospects  

• Number of personalized outreach messages  

• Connection acceptance rate  

• Number of genuine conversations started

title: Real Estate Market Research and Site Selection
description:
Real Estate Market Research & Site Selection VA

Part-Time | Remote | $3–$5 USD/hour | Long-Term Growth Opportunity



Hello! I am looking for a reliable, organized, analytical, and tech-savvy Virtual Assistant to help identify future locations for Walnut Center, a wellness business offering non-medical massage and spa-related services.



This is not a traditional property management or general administrative VA role. Your main mission is to research markets, identify suitable properties, verify zoning and business-use potential, communicate with property owners or agents, and bring me a shortlist of qualified locations that are ready for review.



I will train you on our specific business model, ideal customer, property criteria, and decision-making process. I will also provide the real estate software, AI tools, systems, and paid resources needed to do the work.



What You Will Be Doing Your work will generally follow this process:

1. Market Research

You will research cities, towns, and neighborhoods to determine whether they fit our business model.

This may include:

- Local demographics and customer profile

- Existing massage, spa, and wellness competition

- Nearby businesses and traffic generators

- Market demand

- Location characteristics

- Other factors that may affect the success of the business

Competition does not automatically eliminate an area. Some competition can indicate healthy demand. Your job is to research the market and identify opportunities as well as potential concerns.



2. Property Search

Once a market looks promising, you will search for properties that fit the criteria I provide.

This may include:

- Residential-style properties

- Mixed-use properties

- Commercial properties

- Standalone buildings

- Privately owned properties

We may sometimes prefer standalone or privately owned properties instead of large shopping plazas.



3. Zoning and Business-Use Research

For promising areas and properties, you will research:

- Township, city, or county zoning

- Zoning maps

- Permitted uses

- Mixed-use or commercial classifications

- Whether our intended business use appears to be allowed

You are not expected to make legal zoning decisions. If something is unclear, your job is to identify the issue, verify it when possible, and flag it for further review.



4. Owner and Agent Outreach

Once a property appears to fit:

- Identify the owner, landlord, or listing agent

- Confirm whether the property is still available

- Contact the owner or agent

- Ask whether the intended business use would be acceptable

- Gather additional property information

- Coordinate a showing when appropriate

- Record all communication and follow-up



5. Evaluate and Present Opportunities

You will organize the strongest properties and compare them based on the criteria provided.

The goal is to present me with qualified opportunities where much of the front-end work has already been completed.

A property presented for final review should ideally already have information on:

- Market fit

- Competition

- Property details

- Zoning

- Business-use potential

- Availability

- Owner or agent communication

- Important concerns

- Recommended next step

The goal is not to send me as many listings as possible.

The goal is to identify the best locations that actually fit our business model and can move forward quickly.

Typical Day-to-Day Work

A typical day may involve researching a new market, analyzing competitors, checking township zoning websites, searching Zillow or other property platforms, using PropStream to research ownership, updating our property tracker, contacting agents or landlords, following up on active opportunities, and ranking properties for review.

You will also use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and similar platforms to make research faster and more efficient.

AI should help you analyze and organize information, but you must still verify important facts independently.

Required Skills

You should be strong in:

- Real estate and property research

- Market research and competitive analysis

- Online research

- Critical thinking and business judgment

- Organizing and comparing information

- Google Sheets or Excel

- AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Grok

- Written and spoken English

- Professional phone communication

- Learning new software quickly

- Following through without constant supervision

- Attention to detail

You must be comfortable calling U.S. property owners, landlords, and real estate agents.

Preferred Experience

Experience with any of the following is a strong plus:

- Real estate market research

- Site selection

- Residential or commercial real estate

- Mixed-use properties

- PropStream

- Zillow

- 

- LoopNet

- Crexi

- County GIS systems

- Township or municipal zoning research

- Public property records

- Lead generation

- Skip tracing

- Cold calling

- CRM systems

Experience with massage, spa, wellness, or similar service businesses is also a plus, but not required. I can train you on our specific business model.

What I Care About Most

I am not looking for someone who only knows how to search Zillow and copy information into a spreadsheet.

I am looking for someone who can research, think, compare options, spot problems, ask good questions, and help move an opportunity forward.

When information is unclear or conflicting, I would rather you flag it and investigate than guess.

A good personality also matters. This is a small growing company, and I want someone who communicates well, enjoys working with the team, and is interested in building something long term.

Schedule

Approximately 10–20 hours per week to start.

Some availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours will be required for calls with property owners and real estate agents.

Pay

$3–$5 USD per hour, depending on experience and ability.

This is intended to be a long-term role.

For someone who performs well, shows good judgment, and grows with the company, there is significant opportunity for:

- Increased compensation

- More hours

- Greater responsibility

- Training future team members

- Supervising other VAs

- Moving into a management role as the company expands



How to Apply

Please include the following:

1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your expected hourly rate

3. Your weekly availability

4. Your real estate or property research experience

5. Your experience with market or competitive analysis

6. Your experience with cold calling, lead generation, or contacting property owners

7. Real estate software you have used

8. AI tools you currently use and how you use them

9. Whether you are interested in a long-term position

Required Scenario Question

Please answer the following:

Imagine I ask you to find a new Walnut Center location in Pennsylvania. Walk me through your process from start to finish.

Explain how you would:

- Determine whether the market fits our business model

- Research competitors and demand

- Research zoning and permitted business use

- Find suitable properties

- Verify the property's information

- Contact the owner or agent

- Confirm potential business use

- Coordinate a showing

- Compare and rank the opportunities

- D
 which properties are ready to present to me

You do not need to know our exact business criteria yet.

I want to understand how you think and approach a problem, not whether you already know our system.

Voice Recording Required

Please also send a 60–90 second voice recording answering:

- Who are you?

- What relevant experience do you have?

- Why does this position interest you?

- How comfortable are you speaking with U.S. property owners and real estate agents?

Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



Please begin your application with:

WELLNESS PROPERTY

Selected candidates may be invited to complete a short paid research exercise followed by a video interview.

title: Senior Marketing Manager (Inbound Funnel Owner, B2B Amazon Agency)
description:
We are an Amazon advertising and brand-growth agency. We run the Amazon channel for about 25 consumer brands as their fractional Amazon COO: ads, listings, creative, catalog, inventory and strategy. Small team, fully remote, and you report to the two founders.



THE JOB



You own how brands find us and book a call: the website, search, content, the newsletter, paid tests and the booking path. Your number is qualified calls booked.



We are hiring a senior marketer who d
 what to do next and does it. You bring us ideas every week. When Amazon ships a change or an industry event like Amazon Accelerate happens, you have a post drafted that week and a plan for how it feeds the funnel. Nobody hands you a task list.



WHAT YOU OWN



- Our website: pages, search, and the path from first visit to booked call.

- Content: posts, articles and short video on what is happening in Amazon selling, published while the news still matters.

- The newsletter: what we send, to whom, how often, and whether the list grows.

- Paid tests: small, measured tests with a budget and a stop rule set before they start.

- The booking path: every inbound lead reaches a booked call or a clear no, and our sales lead gets it the same day.

- The weekly report: calls booked, where each came from, what you shipped, what you will change. Numbers, not a list of tasks marked done.



WHAT WE MEASURE



Qualified calls booked from inbound. Qualified means the person fits our target, has authority, shows up engaged, and agrees to a second meeting.



WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE



Day 30: you have audited the funnel, named the biggest leak, and shipped the first fix. Your weekly report arrives unasked.

Day 60: a content and newsletter calendar you set is running on schedule, and your first paid test has a written readout.

Day 90: you can show which channel produced each qualified call, and you are putting more behind the ones that work.



WHAT YOU NEED



- Several years owning inbound marketing for a B2B service business, agency or SaaS company, with booked calls or pipeline as your number.

- A whole funnel you have owned, from traffic to booked call.

- Search and website conversion.

- Writing in English that a brand owner reads to the end. You can turn a news item into a useful post in a day.

-
 and newsletter tools. Ours runs in GoHighLevel; we will train it.

- Paid acquisition on LinkedIn, Google or Meta, on small budgets, with results you report straight.

- Analytics and attribution: you can tell us where a lead came from.

- Daily use of AI tools in your work.

- The habit of bringing ideas without being asked.



A plus: Amazon, ecommerce or agency marketing experience.



Hours: daily overlap with US Pacific business hours, enough to meet the founders live.



HOW TO APPLY



Put the phrase OWN THE FUNNEL at the top of your application. Use this exact phrase for this role only. We do not read applications without it.



Then send:

1. Your resume, LinkedIn or portfolio.

2. A funnel you owned: the channels, what it produced (leads, booked calls, pipeline) and over what period. If you do not have the numbers, say so. Do not estimate.

3. One idea you would ship in your first two weeks to get an Amazon agency more booked calls. Three sentences at most.

4. What you use AI for each week.

5. The hours you can work each weekday, in US Pacific time.

6. Your monthly rate in USD.



HOW WE HIRE



We hire slowly and on purpose.

1. Application. We reply to every complete application within 5 business days, yes or no.

2. Work sample, about 45 minutes: a one-page 30-day plan for our website (we share the link at this step), plus a 3 to 5 minute screen recording of a campaign or funnel you built.

3. Video call with a founder, built around your work sample.

4. Paid trial for finalists on a real piece of our marketing. You are paid whether or not we hire you.

5. Offer. Both founders review your work first.

title: Storyteller Video Editor for Emotionally Powerful Founder Content
description:
Job Title: Storyteller Video Editor for Emotionally Powerful Founder Content

We are looking for a deeply creative video editor who knows how to turn direct-to-camera footage into emotionally moving visual stories.

This is not a role for someone who just adds captions, cuts clips, and follows trends. We want an editor with real storytelling instinct — someone who understands emotion, pacing, silence, sound, music, imagery, and restraint. Someone who knows how to protect the humanity of the speaker, not edit it away.

You will be editing BRAVE 365 content for a growing wellbeing and personal transformation brand. The footage is personal, reflective, and message-driven. Your job is to shape it into cinematic, emotionally resonant pieces that feel honest, powerful, and human — then create shorter campaign and social edits from the same source material.

You must be able to:

Edit direct-to-camera footage into compelling story-led videos

Use B-roll, stock footage, imagery, movement, sound, and music with intention

Create multiple short-form assets from one longer piece

Preserve the speaker’s natural voice, pauses, emotion, and presence

Communicate clearly and professionally in English

Work confidently in Descript

Understand commercial licensing and only use footage, music, and assets that are legally safe for business use

You may be a strong fit if:

You are more of a storyteller than a technician

You know when to do less, not more

You can feel emotional rhythm and shape a viewer’s experience

You understand how to support a message without making it feel overproduced

You want to build a long-term creative partnership, not just complete tasks

To apply, please follow these instructions carefully:

Put Storyteller Video Editor in the subject line or first line of your application

Send 2-3 samples that best show emotional storytelling, not just flashy editing

Tell us what editing tools you use, including your experience with Descript

Write a short paragraph explaining how you approach editing direct-to-camera content without losing the speaker’s humanity

Confirm your level of spoken and written English

Important:

We are not looking for a template editor or someone who mass-applies to every job. We are looking for someone with taste, emotional intelligence, strong English comprehension, and genuine storytelling ability.

Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid test edit using real footage.

title: Social Media Director (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
Job Title: Social Media Director | Managing 2 Accounts for TikTok, Instagram & Paid Ads | Full-Time

About Us

REformered is a pilates fitness and wellness studio located in Lanham, Maryland, USA. At REFORMERED, our mission is to reform body and mind through movement. We're building a brand people follow, trust, find community and buy from, and we're looking for a Social Media Director who will own our social presence and turn it into a real growth engine for followers, customers, and sales.



The Role

You will lead our social media strategy from start to finish: planning the content calendar, turning our raw footage into scroll-stopping content, running paid ads, and tracking what drives followers, leads, and sales.



I will upload raw content to a shared Google Drive. You will tell me what to film each week with a clear shot list, then edit that footage into finished content for every platform. You'll work directly with me, the founder, with a lot of trust and independence.



What You Will Do



Strategy and planning

• Build and manage a monthly content calendar across TikTok and Instagram (Reels, carousels, and static posts)

• Set clear goals and benchmarks for growth, engagement, and sales

• Spot trends, formats, and sounds early and adapt them to our brand



Content creation and publishing

• Turn raw footage from our Google Drive into polished short-form videos, carousels, and graphics

• Write captions, hooks, and calls to action in our brand voice

• Schedule and publish consistently, repurposing content for each platform

• Send a weekly shot list so I always know exactly what to create



Paid ads and growth

• Plan, launch, and manage paid campaigns on Meta (Instagram/Facebook) and TikTok

• Test creatives, audiences, and offers, and optimize for cost per lead and cost per sale

• Recommend how to allocate ad budget (budget amount and final approval stay with me)

• Report on spend, results, and next steps



Community and marketing

• Manage comments, DMs, and mentions to build real relationships with followers

• Bring ideas for promotions, launches, collaborations, and UGC or influencer partnerships

• Use social channels to bring in customers and sales, not just followers



Reporting

• Send a short weekly analytics summary: what worked, what didn't, and what you'll change



What We're Looking For

• 2+ years managing social media for a brand (lifestyle, wellness, beauty, or consumer brands preferred)

• A portfolio of short-form videos you edited yourself

• Hands-on experience running paid ads on Meta and/or TikTok, with results you can show

• Strong copywriting skills and a good eye for consistent visual branding

• Comfortable with CapCut, Canva, Meta Business Suite/Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and a scheduling tool (Later, Buffer, or similar)

• Self-directed, organized, and responsive. You can work independently and communicate clearly in written English

• Reliable internet and a computer capable of video editing



Schedule

Full-time, [40 hours/week]. Daily or weekly check-ins via Googe Meets/WhatsApp

SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY

This position primarily supports our team during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) daytime business hours, Monday-Friday.

The position also includes assigned on-call coverage outside normal business hours, which may include varying evening, overnight and weekend hours in U.S. Eastern Time.



On-call coverage may involve responding to caregiver callouts, cancellations, open shifts and other time-sensitive scheduling changes that require timely attention.



Between regular scheduling responsibilities and assigned on-call coverage, candidates should anticipate a total commitment averaging approximately 50-60 hours per week. The exact distribution of hours may vary from week to week based on scheduling needs and on-call activity.



Applicants should carefully consider the time difference between their location and U.S. Eastern Time before applying. Reliable availability during the required U.S. hours and assigned on-call periods is essential.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 and electronic communications throughout assigned working hours and on-call periods

• Participate in assigned on-call coverage

• Maintain strict confidentiality of client, caregiver and company information

• Perform other related administrative and scheduling support as needed



QUALIFICATIONS

• Previous scheduling, staffing or workforce coordination experience

• Home health, home care or healthcare scheduling experience strongly preferred

• Experience managing frequent schedule changes, callouts, open shifts and staffing needs

• Strong spoken and written English

• Excellent telephone and customer service skills

• Strong organization, follow-up and attention to detail

• Ability to multitask and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Ability to remain calm and professional during urgent or stressful situations

• Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment

• Comfortable communicating directly with U.S.-based clients, caregivers and management

• Experience with Microsoft Office and cloud-based business systems

• Ability to quickly learn scheduling, CRM and other company software

• Ability to appropriately handle confidential and sensitive information



EQUIPMENT & REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS

As an independent contractor, you must provide and maintain your own:

• Reliable computer suitable for daily business use

• Reliable high-speed internet connection

• Backup plan for internet or power interruptions

• Professional and quiet environment for telephone and Zoom communications

• Current operating system and security updates

• Active firewall and reputable antivirus/endpoint security protection

• Secure, password-protected computer that is not shared with unauthorized individuals

Please take the cost of maintaining your equipment, internet, backup connectivity and required computer security into consideration when determining your contractor bid.



CONTRACTOR COMPENSATION

This is an independent contractor opportunity, not a U.S. employee position.

Compensation will be structured as one agreed monthly contractor payment in U.S. dollars (USD).

The monthly contractor payment is intended to cover the complete scope of the engagement, including regular weekday scheduling responsibilities and assigned on-call coverage. There is not a separate hourly rate or separate on-call payment.

Candidates should base their proposed monthly contractor bid on an expected total commitment averaging approximately 50-60 hours per week, including regular responsibilities and assigned on-call coverage.

Please consider the complete scope of the position, schedule requirements, varying on-call hours, availability expectations and your own equipment, internet and security expenses when determining your proposed monthly contractor bid.

Payment is made monthly on Net 30 terms.



PAID TIME AWAY

The contractor arrangement includes 10 paid days off per year, along with paid holidays.

Because this position supports ongoing client and caregiver scheduling, planned time away must be coordinated in advance to ensure appropriate coverage.



TO APPLY

This is remote, but it is not freelance. Instructions are specific. If a step is written down, it gets done that way. title: Medical Billing Coordinator
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a detail-oriented, organized, and highly communicative Cash Pay Billing & Patient Accounts Coordinator to join our team.



This role is primarily focused on cash-pay billing, patient accounts, payment plans, recurring payments, outstanding balances, and direct patient communication.



This is not primarily an insurance claims-processing position. We already have team members handling insurance-related billing. We need someone who can help ensure that the cash-pay side of our practice is handled accurately, consistently, and professionally.



The ideal candidate will have experience in medical billing, patient accounts, healthcare administration, accounting, or a related field. Accounting experience or a CPA background is a plus, particularly for someone comfortable working with accounts receivable, payment records, and financial reconciliation.



Key Responsibilities



•Manage and follow up on cash-pay patient billing.

•Communicate directly with patients regarding balances, payments, and payment arrangements.

•Set up and monitor patient payment plans

•Follow up on outstanding balances and unpaid accounts

•Process and monitor recurring patient payments

•Manage recurring monthly payments related to tissue storage (eggs, sperm, and embryos)

•Review patient cases to identify billing items that may have been missed (insurance and cash cases)

•Prepare a complete list of applicable billing codes and services for the existing medical biller for each treatment case

•Ensure all relevant services are identified and ready for billing

•Coordinate with the existing medical billing team when additional information is needed

•Maintain accurate patient billing and payment records

•Review accounts for accuracy and completeness

•Assist with accounts receivable tracking and follow-up

•Identify discrepancies or missing payment information and communicate them to the appropriate team member

•Handle patient financial information with professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality

•Ensure patients in treatment and returning patients are current before completion or initiation of care



What We Are Looking For



•Experience with cash-pay medical billing, patient accounts, or healthcare billing

•Experience handling patient payment plans and outstanding balances

•Accounting experience or CPA background is a plus

•Understanding of accounts receivable, payment tracking, and financial records

•Strong written and spoken English

•Comfortable communicating directly with patients about financial matters

•Strong attention to detail when reviewing patient cases and billing information

•Ability to identify missing or incomplete billing items

•Strong organizational and follow-up skills

•Professional, respectful, and empathetic communication style

•Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with the team

•Experience with medical billing or healthcare systems is preferred

•Comfortable working with spreadsheets, payment records, and financial information

•Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling patient and financial information



How to Apply



Please provide:

•A brief introduction about yourself

•Resume and portfolio

•Voice recording using Vocaroo (1-minute introduction)

•A brief description of your experience communicating directly with patients about balances or payments

•A brief description of your medical billing, patient accounts, accounting, or CPA experience, if applicable



Please start your application with the words “Medical Billing” to confirm that you have read the full job description.

title: Remote Customer Service & Business Support
description:
Remote Customer Service & Business Support



We are a growing U.S.-based organization seeking a well-rounded Remote Customer Service & Business Support professional to provide customer outreach, customer service and administrative support across multiple areas of our business.

This is a long-term independent contractor opportunity for someone who is confident communicating with U.S.-based customers, comfortable making outbound calls and able to shift between customer service and general business support as needs change.



We are especially interested in candidates with a combination of cold calling, customer service and administrative experience. Experience with billing, payment support, CRM systems or scheduling is a plus.



SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY

This position primarily supports our team during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours, Monday-Friday.

Some responsibilities may require flexibility outside regular business hours, including occasional scheduling support or assigned on-call coverage based on business needs.

Candidates should be comfortable working U.S. hours and should carefully consider the time difference between their location and U.S. Eastern Time before applying.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 and other communication channels

 communications and routine business correspondence

• Learn and work across multiple business systems and processes

• Coordinate with operations, workforce, finance and other internal team members as needed

• Maintain confidentiality of customer, employee and company information

• Provide additional customer service and administrative support based on changing business needs



QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong spoken and written English

• Excellent telephone communication skills with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with U.S.-based customers

• Previous cold calling, outbound customer outreach, appointment setting, lead generation or sales support experience strongly preferred

• Previous customer service experience required

• General administrative or virtual assistant experience preferred

• Strong organization, follow-up and attention to detail

• Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls when business needs require it

• Ability to build rapport while remaining professional and goal-oriented

• Ability to work independently and consistently follow through on assignments

• Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and changing priorities

• Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment

EQUIPMENT & REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS

As an independent contractor, you must provide and maintain your own:

Please take the cost of maintaining your equipment, internet, backup connectivity and required computer security into consideration when determining your contractor bid.

MedPro Disposal is the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company, serving 35,000+ healthcare providers across 48 states for the past 15 years. On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. MP1 Solutions extends MedPro Disposal's operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading — with a technology-forward approach that's making this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that, backed by 15 years of MedPro Disposal's operational credibility — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.

s, updates, reports, presentations)

• Maintain structured systems for tracking tasks, projects, and key initiatives

• Manage competing priorities with a high level of organization and attention to detail

On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. MP1 Solutions extends MedPro Disposal's operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading — with a technology-forward approach that's making this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that, backed by 15 years of MedPro Disposal's operational credibility — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.

title: Senior Fulfilment and Last Mile Operations Manager
description:
Remote | Full-time



Make the daily decisions that keep deliveries moving, warehouse capacity under control and transport costs balanced.



We are looking for an experienced fulfilment and last mile operations professional to take ownership of the flow of customer orders from our warehouses through to final delivery.



This is a senior, hands-on role with a strong focus on operational judgement. You’ll work closely with the Fulfillment team lead, our warehouse, customer service and transport partners to make practical decisions that balance customer commitments, available space, delivery capacity and cost.



You’ll need to see the whole picture. Sometimes bringing stock forward protects a customer delivery date. Other times, consolidating a linehaul movement makes better commercial sense, or moving stock sooner is necessary to free up warehouse space and keep orders flowing. Your role is to weigh the trade-offs, make the call and ensure the teams involved follow through.



What you’ll be responsible for:



Daily fulfilment decisions: Set priorities across picking, dispatch, stock transfers and delivery, taking account of order readiness, capacity and customer commitments.



Warehouse capacity and stock flow: Work with warehouse leaders to manage space constraints, inbound arrivals and outbound volumes, preventing congestion and unnecessary handling.



Linehaul planning: Balance transfer timing, load utilization and transport costs against stock availability and warehouse capacity.



Last mile delivery: Manage courier and delivery partner performance, bookings, service standards and delivery exceptions.



Customer outcomes: Work with customer service to identify delivery risks early, agree realistic solutions and ensure customers receive clear updates.



Exception management: Resolve competing priorities, delayed movements, failed deliveries and urgent orders, understanding the wider impact of each decision.



Commercial performance: Monitor cost per delivery, linehaul utilisation, redelivery costs and other controllable expenses, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.



Team coordination: Give clear direction, establish ownership and hold internal teams and external partners accountable for agreed actions.



Back office Admin: Leading our back office admin team who liaises with locally based suppliers, will also form part of this positions' remit.



Continuous improvement: Strengthen processes, reporting and systems so the operation becomes more reliable and easier to manage.



You’ll also step into the operation when needed—investigating an issue on the warehouse floor, checking an order or helping the team through a peak period.



What you’ll bring

Strong experience in fulfilment, transport or last mile operations, ideally within furniture, bulky goods, retail or a similar delivery environment.



Experience coordinating warehouses, interstate linehaul movements and external delivery partners.



The ability to make sound decisions when priorities compete and information is incomplete.



Commercial awareness: you understand how delivery promises, stock movements, storage constraints and transport choices affect cost and service.



Confidence using operational data and warehouse, ERP and delivery systems to identify issues and guide decisions.



Clear communication and the ability to work effectively with warehouse teams, customer service, suppliers and senior management.



A practical approach, strong follow-through and a willingness to get involved when needed.



What success looks like



Customer orders move predictably from warehouse to delivery. Stock transfers are planned with both capacity and cost in mind. Delivery risks are identified early, avoidable costs are reduced, and everyone involved understands the priorities and their responsibilities.

title: Experienced Part Time Appointment Setter (3+ Years Cold Calling Sales) for Commercial Cleaning, Healthcare Offices (US)
description:
Keeper Facility Care is a commercial cleaning company for healthcare offices in Fairfield County, Connecticut (
). We need one experienced part time appointment setter to reach the decision maker at healthcare offices and book short walkthroughs. This is a sales job. We are not looking for beginners.



THE JOB

You work from a list we give you. Your one goal is a booked 15 minute walkthrough with the decision maker: the office manager, practice manager, administrator or owner.



Your standard is 100 or more dials every working day, from day one. A dial is one call attempt to one number. The same number twice in one day counts once.



Your work:

You call the decision maker directly on their business line when we have it, and you call the office main line and get through to them.

You follow up by
, and by text to numbers the prospect gave you.

You answer inbound calls and return missed calls from offices we have already contacted.

You log every call in our CRM and send a confirmation within 10 minutes of each booking.



Your rules:

You dial by hand, call business lines only, never quote prices, never promise anything free, never claim we do something we do not do, and stop when someone says do not call.



Most calls end at the front desk or in voi
. That is normal. We want someone who stays polite and keeps dialing.



HOW WE SELL

This is not a job where you read a script. We give you talking points and guardrails, and you have a natural conversation. We want someone who sounds confident and human on the phone, listens, and understands why a clean office matters to a healthcare practice: its patients, its staff and its reputation. Worked at a commercial cleaning, janitorial or facility services company? That is a strong plus.



HOURS

20 hours per week, Monday to Friday, mostly Tuesday to Thursday. Calls run 10 AM to 12 PM and 1 PM to 4 PM US Eastern time. In Philippine time that is 10 PM to 12 AM and 1 AM to 4 AM until November 1, then one hour later because US clocks change. These are US business hours, so they fall at night in the Philippines. Apply only if you can work these hours every week. Hours can grow for strong performers.



PAY

$5 to $7 per hour depending on experience, paid weekly in USD by Wise or Payoneer.

$25 for every walkthrough that actually happens.

$50, $75 or $100 for every office that signs, based on contract size ($1,400 to $2,000 a month, $2,001 to $3,000, $3,001 and up). Paid after we collect the first invoice.

Bonuses are extra and not promised.



TRIAL

The first 80 hours are a paid trial. We track dials, decision maker conversations, walkthroughs booked and walkthroughs held on a weekly scorecard. Then we review your numbers together and d
 whether to continue. You sign a contractor agreement with confidentiality and non-compete terms before day one.



WE PROVIDE

A US phone number and dialer, our CRM, the call list, talking points and objection answers, written playbooks for calling, CRM use and the weekly scorecard, role-play training in week one, and a 15 minute performance review every week.



YOU NEED

At least 3 years of experience as an outbound cold calling appointment setter, booking appointments for service businesses, to businesses or to consumers. Home services, cleaning, healthcare, insurance and similar services count. Calling US customers for a client, at a call center or as a freelancer, counts. If you do not have 3 years of appointment setting by cold calling, do not apply.

You have made 100 or more cold calls a day before, and you know how to get past a front desk and reach the decision maker. You stay calm after a lot of no's.

A natural, confident phone presence. You sound like a person, not a script.

Daily experience using a CRM, and clean call notes.

Clear spoken English that a US office manager understands on the first call.

A computer, a USB headset, a quiet room, and 10 Mbps upload speed.



HOW TO APPLY

Put this title on the first line of your message: KEEPER, [the hourly pay range in this post], [your name]. I do not read messages without it.



Then send:



1. A link to a 30 to 45 second voice recording. Do not read a script. Introduce yourself in one sentence. Then imagine you reached the office manager at a dental office and said: "Hi, this is [your name] with Keeper Facility Care. We provide janitorial service to healthcare offices near you. Are you the person who d
 on cleaning?" The manager says: "We already have a cleaner." Answer in your own words and ask for a 15 minute walkthrough. Make sure the link opens without a login.

2. Your years of cold calling appointment setting experience, what services you booked appointments for, who you called, calls per day, and your best measurable result, such as appointments booked per week. Tell us if you have worked for a cleaning or facility services company.

3. The CRMs you have used.

4. Your expected hourly rate in USD.

5. Your upload speed, your headset model, and a yes or no: can you work the hours above every week?



Applications that do not follow these instructions are not reviewed. Finalists do a 10 minute live role-play call with me.



Applications close Monday, October 12 at 11:59 PM Philippine time. I reply only to finalists, by Wednesday, October 14.



Johan Montenegro, Keeper Facility Care

title: Wedding Photo Editor: Imagen AI Gallery Finishing
description:
About us

We're a busy Sydney-based wedding photography and videography studio, and we're looking for a detail-obsessed Lightroom editor to finish our wedding galleries. Most of the heavy lifting is already done before the catalog reaches you. Your job is to make each gallery look flawless.



Our workflow

- Our photography assistant culls the gallery.

- We run the selects through Imagen AI to apply our base preset.

- You finish the gallery. That's where you come in.



What you'll do

- Review every image in the Imagen-edited Lightroom catalog

- Fix colour, white balance, exposure and contrast so the whole gallery is consistent from getting ready through to the dance floor

- Keep skin tones natural and consistent across changing light

- Remove distractions: background people, exit signs, bins, power points, stray objects, photobombers

- Tidy up crops and straighten horizons where needed

- Return the finished catalog by the agreed deadline



What this is NOT

You won't be culling or building a look from scratch. Our preset and reference galleries set the style. We need you to execute it perfectly on every frame.



You must have

- Expert with Adobe Lightroom Classic (not Lightroom mobile/CC)

- Proven wedding editing experience, with full finished galleries to show for it

- Expert with Lightroom's Remove, Heal and masking tools (Photoshop is a bonus)

- Experience finishing AI-edited catalogs (Imagen or Aftershoot) is a big plus

- A great eye for consistency and the small details other people miss

- A reliable computer and fast internet for large catalog transfers

- Clear written English and reliable communication



Rate and volume

- $0.15 to $0.20 AUD per image depending on experience, paid per gallery

- Galleries are roughly [600–1,500] images

- Turnaround: [3–5] business days per gallery

- Ongoing work as part of a growing team for the right person



How to apply

- Start your application with the word "FINISHER" so we know you read the whole post. Include:

- A short intro about your wedding editing experience

- A link to at least one full wedding gallery you've finished (a full day or a large chunk of one, not a highlights reel). We're assessing consistency of colour, exposure and overall look across the whole gallery, so portfolios of single "best" photos won't be considered. Before/after examples of distraction removal are a bonus.

- The AI editing tools you've used (Imagen, Aftershoot, etc.)

- Your rate per image

- Your computer specs and internet speed



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to do a paid test on a real gallery.

s based on information provided by the client's team

s and following up with prospects

 marketing and outreach campaigns
